descriptions.it:
We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly structured leader to head the Business Management domain within the Product & Development (P&D) business area, specifically within Product Delivery & Quality division.
In this role, you will ensure the P&D organisation operates smoothly, transparently, and in alignment with strategic and financial priorities.
You will lead a domain encompassing Financial Planning, Quarterly Product Planning (or also known as QBR), Reporting, and Communications – while personally driving key strategic, organisational, and leadership initiatives.
This role requires strong business acumen, willingness to drive the change providing input, excellent communication skills, and the ability to partner effectively across senior leadership, technology teams, Controlling, HR, Corporate Communications, Vendor Management, and other business functions.
Your key tasks
- Drive P&D business strategy and ensure alignment across all divisions
- Coordinate organisational design, workforce planning, and leadership offsites
- Own processes around positions approvals, external workforce approvals, data access governance, and support organisational changes
- Oversee financial planning across P&D organisation, including APC, budgeting, forecasting, and TPR/TSR preparation and partner with Controlling to ensure consistent financial governance and reporting in order to support divisional leaders in financial steering
- Own and evolve the PMO service for P&D business area
- Ensure data quality, consistency, and alignment with respect to capacity, demand, and budget
- Act as escalation point for prioritisation and planning conflicts or inconsistencies
- Define, evolve, and prioritise the P&D reporting landscape
- Ensure clear, reliable insights are available for senior leadership decision making
- Own P&D-wide communication strategy, including newsletters, Business Talks, and town-halls
- Ensure P&D newsletters are issued timely, are engaging, and aligned with Corporate Communications
- Lead and coach your team, fostering collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement
- Define expectations, operating rhythms, and capability development across the Business Management organisation
- Drive a culture of trust, clarity, and operational excellence
 

## Qualifiche

- Proven experience as a leader specifically in business management within a technology company, finance, or PMO in a complex organisation
-  You will exhibit strong financial acumen and experience with budgeting, forecasting, and controlling
- Ability to translate strategy into structure, processes, and measurable outcomes
- Strong track record of working with data, reporting tooling, and KPI frameworks
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills at executive level
- Ability to lead through complexity, prioritise across competing demands, and handle sensitive topics with discretion
- Experience of leading and managing a team and developing their performance
- Solid experience in driving meaningful transformation in planning, reporting, communication, and strategy

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

descriptions.it: # Il ruolo Sarete parte di un team globale in tre diverse sedi (Germania, Svizzera e Singapore), che è responsabile per i trasferimenti di titoli (trasferimenti di portafoglio e riallineamenti), così come la gestione delle azioni registrate. Attività operative quotidiane che coprono Equity, Bonds, Structure Notes, Mutual and Hedge Fund. # Le marta responsabili Trattamento dei trasferimenti in entrata e in uscita di titoli in Avaloq Banking SuiteProcessing dei riallineamenti tra diversi depositari e mercati Azioni di controllo/coordinamento con i clienti, i dipartimenti commerciali e i custodiCash e la riconciliazione di sicurezza Garantire che tutte le transazioni siano trattate correttamente e regolate in modo tempestivoCompliance with Services Level Agreements (SLA), KRI/KPI e tenersi al passo dei cambiamenti di mercato/regolatorio # Il tuo profilo Securities Transfer o Settlement experience è un plus, così come le competenze di tecnologia e soluzioni (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Avaloq Banking Suite, Clearstream Vestima, SWIFT, Bloomberg) Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente veloce e gestisce bene durante un ambiente stressante Un giocatore di squadra orientato al servizio e ha una forte motivazione per far parte di un team dinamicoUn lavoratore indipendente e proattivo con buone capacità di comunicazione Fluency in inglese e tedesco ## Informazioni aggiuntive Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali. In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico. Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro. Si prega di essere consapevoli del fatto che non accetteremo le richieste di CV speculativi per uno dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi candidatura non richiesta sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento. #LI-HybridBenefitsAnnual bonus A Avaloq lavoriamo duramente per rimanere un fornitore leader del settore e ci piace premiare i nostri colleghi con una parte di quel successo con un bonus annuale, si rimarrà anche eleggibile per il bonus annuale mentre si fa il lavoro più duro della vostra vita – prendendosi cura dei vostri bambini durante il congedo parentale. Lavoro flessibile Sappiamo che adattare la vostra vita intorno al vostro lavoro può essere stimolante, motivo per cui nella maggior parte dei ruoli offriamo lavoro flessibile per consentire di prosperare sia dentro che fuori dal lavoro. Riconoscimento immediato Ci piace vedere le persone che prosperano nei loro ruoli e abbiamo uno schema di riconoscimento istantaneo a Avaloq per aiutare i manager a premiare il grande lavoro che i nostri colleghi offrono con un regalo per dire grazie. Accesso a Udemy per l'apprendimento professionale e personale Pensiamo che sia importante imparare e crescere professionalmente, ma se sei qualcuno che ama imparare al di fuori del lavoro ti diamo accesso all'apprendimento online per l'apprendimento sia professionale che personale, con oltre 210.000 corsi tra cui scegliere. Su di noiCon sede in Svizzera, Avaloq sta espandendo continuamente la sua impronta globale con circa 2.500 colleghi in 12 paesi e oltre 170 clienti in 35 paesi. Siamo un fornitore leader del settore di tecnologia di gestione della ricchezza e servizi per le istituzioni finanziarie in tutto il mondo, tra cui banche private e gestori di ricchezza, gestori di investimenti, così come al dettaglio e banche neo. La nostra ricerca ha condotto l'approccio e la continua innovazione è alimentata dalla passione e dalla creatività dei nostri colleghi. Siamo sempre alla ricerca di persone di talento per unirsi a noi nella nostra missione di orchestrare l'ecosistema finanziario e democratizzare l'accesso alla gestione della ricchezza. Avaloq offre l’opportunità di lavorare a stretto contatto con alcune delle principali istituzioni finanziarie del mondo, sviluppando e modellando insieme le carriere. Campionere di un ambiente di lavoro collaborativo, di supporto e flessibile consente ai nostri colleghi di raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Carriere
descriptions.en:
## Il ruolo

You will be part of a global team in three different locations (Germany, Switzerland, and Singapore), which is responsible for the transfers of securities (portfolio transfers and realignments), as well as the management of registered shares. Daily operational activities covering Equities, Bonds, Structure Notes, Mutual and Hedge Fund.

## Le tue responsabilita

Processing of incoming and outgoing securities transfers in Avaloq Banking SuiteProcessing of realignments between various custodians and marketsControl actions/coordination with clients, trade departments and custodiansCash and security reconciliationEnsuring that all transactions are processed correctly and settled in a timely mannerCompliance with Services Level Agreements (SLA), KRI/KPI and keeping oneself abreast of market/regulatory changes

## Il tuo profilo

Securities Transfer or Settlement experience is a plus, as well as Technology and Solutions skills (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Avaloq Banking Suite, Clearstream Vestima, SWIFT, Bloomberg)Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handles well during a stressful environmentA service-orientated team player and has a strong motivation to be part of a dynamic teamAn independent and proactive worker with good communication skillsFluency in English and German

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations. #LI-HybridBenefitsAnnual bonusAt Avaloq we work hard to remain an industry leading provider and we love to reward our colleagues with a share of that success with an annual bonus, you will even remain eligible for annual bonus while you do the hardest job of your life – taking care of your children during parental leave.Flexible workingWe understand that fitting your life around your job can be challenging which is why in most roles we offer flexible working to allow you to thrive both in and out of work.Instant recognitionWe love to see people thriving in their roles and we have an instant recognition scheme at Avaloq to help managers reward the great work our colleagues deliver with a gift to say thanks.Access to Udemy for professional and personal learningWe think it is important to learn and grow professionally, but if you are someone who likes to learn outside of work we give you access to online learning for both professional and personal learning, with over 210,000 courses to choose from.About usFounded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues. We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.Careers
descriptions.de: oder In den Warenkorb Sie werden Teil eines globalen Teams an drei verschiedenen Standorten (Deutschland, Schweiz und Singapur) sein, das für die Übertragung von Wertpapieren (Portfolio-Transfers und Realignments) sowie die Verwaltung von Aktien verantwortlich ist. Tägliche operative Aktivitäten für Eigenkapital, Anleihen, Strukturnotizen, Mutual and Hedge Fund. oder Le Dienstag responsabilita Verarbeitung von eingehenden und abgehenden Wertpapiertransfers in Avaloq Banking SuiteBearbeitung von Neuausrichtungen zwischen verschiedenen Kunden und Märkten Kontrollmaßnahmen/Koordination mit Kunden, Fachabteilungen und KundenCash- und SicherheitsabgleichUm sicherzustellen, dass alle Transaktionen korrekt verarbeitet und rechtzeitig geregelt werdenCompliance with Services Level Agreements (SLA), KRI/KPI und halten sich selbst am Markt / Regulierungsänderungen oder Il tuo profilo Securities Transfer oder Settlement Erfahrung ist ein Plus, sowie Technologie und Lösungen Fähigkeiten (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Avaloq Banking Suite, Clearstream Vestima, SWIFT, Bloomberg) Fähigkeit, in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu arbeiten und gut in einer stressigen Umgebung zu handhaben Ein serviceorientierter Teamplayer und hat eine starke Motivation, Teil eines dynamischen Teams zu seinEin unabhängiger und proaktiver Arbeiter mit guten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Fluency in Englisch und Deutsch Wir erkennen, dass das Management von Arbeitslebensbilanz eine Herausforderung ist, die wir alle in unserem täglichen Leben stellen und um damit zu unterstützen, freuen wir uns, für die meisten unserer Avaloqers eine hybride und flexible Arbeit anbieten zu können, um das Arbeitslebensgleichgewicht zu erhalten und unsere fantastische Avaloq-Kultur in unseren globalen Büros fortzusetzen. In Avaloq sind wir stolz darauf, Vielfalt zu akzeptieren und zu verstehen, dass der Erfolg unseres Unternehmens auf der Macht verschiedener Meinungen aufgebaut ist, sind wir ganz herzlich dazu verpflichtet, eine Chancengleichheitsumgebung und inklusive Kultur zu fördern, in der Sie Ihr wahres authentisches Selbst sein können. Wir mieten, kompensieren und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder anderen fantastischen Eigenschaften, die uns alle einzigartig machen, haben wir unser Bestes getan, um diese Anzeige in inklusive und neutral zu schreiben. Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir keine spekulativen Bewerbungsunterlagen für eine unserer Aufgaben von Rekrutierungsagenturen akzeptieren werden, und alle nicht ausdrücklichen Bewerbungsunterlagen werden von den Zahlungserwartungen befreit. #LI-HybridBenefitsAnnual bonus Bei Avaloq arbeiten wir hart daran, ein branchenführender Anbieter zu bleiben, und wir lieben es, unsere Kollegen mit einem Anteil dieses Erfolgs mit einem jährlichen Bonus zu belohnen, Sie werden sogar für einen jährlichen Bonus förderfähig bleiben, während Sie die härteste Arbeit Ihres Lebens tun – sich um Ihre Kinder während des Elternurlaubs kümmern. Flexibles Arbeiten Wir verstehen, dass das Anpassen Ihres Lebens um Ihren Job herausfordern kann, weshalb wir in den meisten Rollen flexibles Arbeiten anbieten, um Ihnen zu ermöglichen, sowohl in als auch außerhalb der Arbeit zu leben. Sofortige Anerkennung Wir lieben es, die Menschen in ihren Rollen blühen zu sehen und wir haben ein sofortiges Anerkennungsschema bei Avaloq, um Managern zu helfen, die große Arbeit, die unsere Kollegen mit einem Geschenk zu belohnen, zu danken. Zugang zu Udemy für professionelles und persönliches Lernen Wir halten es für wichtig, professionell zu lernen und zu wachsen, aber wenn Sie jemand sind, der gerne außerhalb der Arbeit lernen, geben wir Ihnen Zugang zu Online-Lernen für professionelles und persönliches Lernen, mit über 210.000 Kursen zu wählen. Über uns Mit rund 2.500 Kollegen in 12 Ländern und mehr als 170 Kunden in 35 Ländern erweitert Avaloq seinen globalen Fußabdruck kontinuierlich. Wir sind ein branchenführender Anbieter von Vermögensmanagement-Technologien und Dienstleistungen für Finanzinstitute auf der ganzen Welt, darunter private Banken und Vermögensverwalter, Investment Manager sowie Einzelhandel und Neobanken. Unsere Forschung führte Ansatz und kontinuierliche Innovation wird von der Leidenschaft und Kreativität unserer Kollegen angetrieben. Wir sind immer auf der Suche nach talentierten Menschen, uns auf unserer Mission beizutreten, das Finanzökosystem zu orchestrieren und den Zugang zum Vermögensmanagement zu demokratisch zu machen. Avaloq bietet die Möglichkeit, eng mit einigen der weltweit führenden Finanzinstitute zu arbeiten, da wir gemeinsam Karrieren entwickeln und gestalten. Mit einem kollaborativen, unterstützenden und flexiblen Arbeitsumfeld erreichen unsere Kollegen ihr volles Potenzial. Karriere

Certificazione Avaloq, principalmente per coprire i problemi della piattaformaLa conoscenza degli strumenti facile è un valore aggiuntoStrong analitica, problem solving e competenze concettuali Eccellente customer-orientation e capacità di comunicazione Fluente in inglese parlato e scritto ## Informazioni Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali. In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico. Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro. Si prega di essere consapevoli del fatto che non accetteremo le richieste di CV speculativi per uno dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi candidatura non richiesta sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento. #LI-HybridBenefitsAnnual bonus A Avaloq lavoriamo duramente per rimanere un fornitore leader del settore e ci piace premiare i nostri colleghi con una parte di quel successo con un bonus annuale, si rimarrà anche eleggibile per il bonus annuale mentre si fa il lavoro più duro della vostra vita – prendendosi cura dei vostri bambini durante il congedo parentale. Lavoro flessibile Sappiamo che adattare la vostra vita intorno al vostro lavoro può essere stimolante, motivo per cui nella maggior parte dei ruoli offriamo lavoro flessibile per consentire di prosperare sia dentro che fuori dal lavoro. descriptions.en:
## Il ruolo

The Avaloq Platform & Security team in the Application Management Services is responsible to provide application maintenance and small enhancements services for the functional area and all related topics for our CH/FL SaaS clients, with particular focus on managing security and visibility settings on ACP.Working location in Swiss it's mandatory; availability to work from the Bioggio (TI) office will be preferred.

## Le tue responsabilita

Provide application management and support for the Avaloq Platform & Security topicsCategorize, analyze and reproduce client issuesProvide workaround for incidentsManage request of information and service requestsRequirement and solution analysis of small enhancementsImplementation of bug fixes and estimation and implementation of small enhancementsEnsure high quality service to the customers in terms of reliable delivery and efficient communication

## Il tuo profilo

University degree in Computer Science/Physics/Engineering/Mathematics or comparable educationAt least 5 years of work experience in the fintech sectorProgramming skills (any programming language, XML, shell scripting, etc.)Avaloq certification, mainly to cover Platform issuesSecureasy tool knowledge it's an added valueStrong analytical, problem solving and conceptual skillsExcellent client-orientation and communication skillsFluent in spoken and written English

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations. #LI-HybridBenefitsAnnual bonusAt Avaloq we work hard to remain an industry leading provider and we love to reward our colleagues with a share of that success with an annual bonus, you will even remain eligible for annual bonus while you do the hardest job of your life – taking care of your children during parental leave.Flexible workingWe understand that fitting your life around your job can be challenging which is why in most roles we offer flexible working to allow you to thrive both in and out of work.Instant recognitionWe love to see people thriving in their roles and we have an instant recognition scheme at Avaloq to help managers reward the great work our colleagues deliver with a gift to say thanks.Access to Udemy for professional and personal learningWe think it is important to learn and grow professionally, but if you are someone who likes to learn outside of work we give you access to online learning for both professional and personal learning, with over 210,000 courses to choose from.About usFounded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 160 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues. We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.Careers

In Avaloq sind wir stolz darauf, Vielfalt zu akzeptieren und zu verstehen, dass der Erfolg unseres Unternehmens auf der Macht verschiedener Meinungen aufgebaut ist, sind wir ganz herzlich dazu verpflichtet, eine Chancengleichheitsumgebung und inklusive Kultur zu fördern, in der Sie Ihr wahres authentisches Selbst sein können. Wir mieten, kompensieren und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder anderen fantastischen Eigenschaften, die uns alle einzigartig machen, haben wir unser Bestes getan, um diese Anzeige in inklusive und neutral zu schreiben. Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir keine spekulativen Bewerbungsunterlagen für eine unserer Aufgaben von Rekrutierungsagenturen akzeptieren werden, und alle nicht ausdrücklichen Bewerbungsunterlagen werden von den Zahlungserwartungen befreit. #LI-HybridBenefitsAnnual bonus Bei Avaloq arbeiten wir hart daran, ein branchenführender Anbieter zu bleiben, und wir lieben es, unsere Kollegen mit einem Anteil dieses Erfolgs mit einem jährlichen Bonus zu belohnen, Sie werden sogar für einen jährlichen Bonus förderfähig bleiben, während Sie die härteste Arbeit Ihres Lebens tun – sich um Ihre Kinder während des Elternurlaubs kümmern. Flexibles Arbeiten Wir verstehen, dass das Anpassen Ihres Lebens um Ihren Job herausfordern kann, weshalb wir in den meisten Rollen flexible Arbeiten anbieten, um Ihnen zu ermöglichen, sowohl in als auch außerhalb der Arbeit zu leben. Sofortige Anerkennung Wir lieben es, die Menschen in ihren Rollen blühen zu sehen, und wir haben ein sofortiges Anerkennungssystem bei Avaloq, um Managern zu helfen, die große Arbeit, die unsere Kollegen mit einem Geschenk zu belohnen, zu danken. Zugang zu Udemy für professionelles und persönliches Lernen Wir halten es für wichtig, professionell zu lernen und zu wachsen, aber wenn Sie jemand sind, der gerne außerhalb der Arbeit lernen, geben wir Ihnen Zugang zu Online-Lernen für professionelles und persönliches Lernen, mit über 210.000 Kursen zu wählen. Über uns Mit rund 2.500 Kollegen in 12 Ländern und mehr als 160 Kunden in 35 Ländern erweitert Avaloq seine globale Präsenz kontinuierlich. Wir sind ein branchenführender Anbieter von Vermögensmanagement-Technologien und Dienstleistungen für Finanzinstitute auf der ganzen Welt, darunter private Banken und Vermögensverwalter, Investment Manager sowie Einzelhandel und Neobanken. Unsere Forschung führte Ansatz und kontinuierliche Innovation wird von der Leidenschaft und Kreativität unserer Kollegen angetrieben. Wir sind immer auf der Suche nach talentierten Menschen, uns auf unserer Mission beizutreten, das Finanzökosystem zu orchestrieren und den Zugang zum Vermögensmanagement zu demokratisch zu machen. Avaloq bietet die Möglichkeit, eng mit einigen der weltweit führenden Finanzinstitute zu arbeiten, da wir gemeinsam Karrieren entwickeln und gestalten. Mit einem kollaborativen, unterstützenden und flexiblen Arbeitsumfeld erreichen unsere Kollegen ihr volles Potenzial. Karriere

descriptions.it:
Banking Operations is a strategic Avaloq service line providing Banking Operations outsourcing services to banks. We are organized as a global Business Area, running state-of-the art Backoffice services with industry leading automation, quality, and risk standards. We are experts in providing a true value add to our clients and thus, always look to add creative and client-oriented personalities with drive and passion to our team.
The Corporate Actions Pre-Processing Team manage events coming from the market affecting the characteristic, the nature, or the value of a security. These events can be mandatory, mandatory with options or voluntary. The activity includes check of incoming messages and ending events, creation of the notification of the Corporate Actions and handling inquiries from clients.
Your key tasks 
- Set up of Mandatory events
- Set up and creation of notifications for Voluntary and Mandatory with choice events
- Check of incoming swift messages
- Handling of enquiries

## Qualifiche

- Economics studies, preferably at university level and with a focus in Finance
- Proactive approach towards a highly challenging, fast-paced and complex environment
- Good communication and organization skills
- Good team player and positive attitude
- Flexibility and willingness to learn
- Fluent in English and German
It would be a real bonus if you have
- Knowledge of Corporate Actions (even if only theoretical)
- Knowledge of Avaloq Core Banking System
- Knowledge of additional languages

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

descriptions.it:
Banking Operations is a strategic Avaloq service line providing Banking Operations outsourcing services to banks. We are organized as a global Business Area, running state-of-the art Backoffice services with industry leading automation, quality, and risk standards. We are experts in providing a true value add to our clients and thus, always look to add creative and client-oriented personalities with drive and passion to our team.
You are applying to the OTC Derivatives Team, within the division of Banking Operations. The team is responsible for the processing and life-cycle management of in-scope products within agreed SLAs and procedures. This includes orders validation, matching of confirmations, cash and position reconciliation with relevant investigations to close open breaks,  listed option transfers and collaboration with the other Banking Operations team to increase efficiency.
Your key tasks
- Timely and accurate processing of OTC Equity and FX derivative products (Accumulators, Decumulators, Swaps, Dual Currency Investment, Structured Investment, FX related products) as well as Interest Rate Swaps, Listed Options and Futures
- Prompt follow-up with relevant parties to resolve any trade exceptions/discrepancies
- Investigating and resolving all outstanding break items (cash and position reconciliations)
- Ensuring that operational delivery covering Derivatives activities is managed within SLAs and KPIs to prevent losses/breaches and mitigate risks
- Escalating any operational risks to Manager for mitigation/solutions
- Supporting Manager in various tasks including process efficiency/improvement and ensuring that information is duly updated in Key Operating Procedure (KOP)
Performing User Acceptance Testing as and when required

## Qualifiche

- Relevant experience in back-office order processing
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
- Proactivity combined with positive attitude and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
- Problem solving and time management skills
- High attention to details, flexibility, and willingness to learn
- Good communicator with ability to build robust relationships with peers and other stakeholders
- Fluency in English and Italian
It would be a real bonus if you have
- Good knowledge of Avaloq system
- Solid technical know-how in the Derivatives areas
- Knowledge of French and German are a plus

## Informazioni aggiuntive

La nostra ricerca ha condotto l'approccio e la continua innovazione è alimentata dalla passione e dalla creatività dei nostri colleghi. Siamo sempre alla ricerca di persone di talento per unirsi a noi nella nostra missione di orchestrare l'ecosistema finanziario e democratizzare l'accesso alla gestione della ricchezza. Avaloq offre l’opportunità di lavorare a stretto contatto con alcune delle principali istituzioni finanziarie del mondo, sviluppando e modellando insieme le carriere. Campionere di un ambiente di lavoro collaborativo, di supporto e flessibile consente ai nostri colleghi di raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Carriere

## Il ruolo

This is an exciting opportunity for you to take a leadership role within the new service operations business area as a Data Platform Manager leading a team of platform administrators, ensuring the delivery of robust, scalable, and secure data platform solutions.You should have a have strong expertise in Oracle technologies, SQL Server, MySQL, cloud platforms, and DevOps methodologies, with a proven track record in managing and mentoring technical teams.

Team Leadership and Management:Lead, mentor, and manage a team of DBAs to achieve organizational objectives Oversee workload distribution, performance evaluations, and professional development Foster a collaborative and high-performance team culture Data Platform Administration:Oversee the design, installation, configuration, and maintenance of Oracle data platforms (on-premises and cloud environments) Ensure platform security, availability, and performance optimization Plan and execute backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures Cloud Expertise:Implement and manage Oracle data platform solutions on cloud platforms (e.g., Oracle Cloud, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) Lead cloud migration initiatives, ensuring minimal downtime and optimal performance Leverage cloud-native tools for monitoring and automation DevOps Methodologies:Integrate DevOps practices into data platform management processes Automate deployment, monitoring, and maintenance tasks using CI/CD pipelines and configuration management tools Collaborate with development teams to ensure seamless platform operations within agile workflows Strategic Planning and Collaboration:Define and execute data platform strategies aligned with business goals Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement data solutions Stay updated with emerging technologies and best practices in Oracle platform, cloud solutions, and DevOps Compliance and Standards:Ensure compliance with industry regulations, organizational policies, and security standards Implement governance frameworks for database operations and cloud resources

7+ years of experience as an oracle platform administrator and 3+ years acting as a leader utilizing your strong communication skills to motivate and manage technical teams in a fast paced environment.An excellent problem solver with in-depth knowledge of Oracle architecture in order to tune performance and troubleshoot issuesExpertise in Oracle platform solutions in cloud environments (Oracle Cloud, AWS RDS, Azure SQL, etc.) Proficiency in DevOps tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, Ansible, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes) Hands-on experience with monitoring and automation tools Full professional fluency in English and Italian

: Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) or higher Cloud certifications (e.g., Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, AWS Certified Database Specialty, Azure Database Administrator Associate) DevOps certifications (e.g., Certified Kubernetes Administrator, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Computer Science or a related fieldGerman or Italian language skillsExperience managing 24x7 operations and regulated environments (e.g., banking or financial services)

BenefitsAnnual bonusAt Avaloq we work hard to remain an industry leading provider and we love to reward our colleagues with a share of that success with an annual bonus, you will even remain eligible for annual bonus while you do the hardest job of your life – taking care of your children during parental leave.Flexible workingWe understand that fitting your life around your job can be challenging which is why in most roles we offer flexible working to allow you to thrive both in and out of work.Instant recognitionWe love to see people thriving in their roles and we have an instant recognition scheme at Avaloq to help managers reward the great work our colleagues deliver with a gift to say thanks.Access to Udemy for professional and personal learningWe think it is important to learn and grow professionally, but if you are someone who likes to learn outside of work we give you access to online learning for both professional and personal learning, with over 210,000 courses to choose from.About usFounded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 12 countries, and more than 170 clients in 35 countries. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.Careers

descriptions.it: Apprendista di commercio AFC A partire da metà agosto 2026 siamo alla ricerca di un/a apprendista di commercio AFC presso la nostra sede a Bioggio. Durante i tre anni di apprendistato, ti offriamo la possibilità di imparare diversi compiti in ambito amministrativo all’interno di un’azienda leader del mercato svizzero per le soluzioni software bancario integrato. Inoltre, trascorrerai 2 giorni alla settimana presso la scuola di apprendistato commerciale e parteciperai di tanto in tanto a corsi interaziendali, dove potrai acquisire ulteriori conoscenze e competenze. Principali compiti e responsabilità: - Fornire supporto amministrativo in varie aree, tra cui contabilità, risorse umane e facility management - Consulenza a clienti, fornitori e dipendenti al telefono o via e-mail - Organizzazione e coordinamento di riunioni ed eventi per vari team - Creazione ed elaborazione di documenti e presentazioni - Elaborazione e riconciliazione di fatture e pagamenti In ogni reparto avrai un referente che si occuperà di te e sarà pronto ad aiutarti per qualsiasi domanda e a darti consigli. Se ti piace lavorare in gruppo e al computer, ti piace il contatto con le persone, sei affidabile e indipendente, allora l'apprendistato commerciale in Avaloq è la strada giusta per te. Sei pronto per il tuo futuro in Avaloq? ## Qualifiche Requisiti necessari: - Buon rendimento scolastico - Spiccato interesse per le tematiche economiche - Adattabilità, motivazione e indipendenza e un forte senso di responsabilità - Buone doti organizzative e propensione al lavoro in team - Attenzione ai dettagli e precisione - Italiano fluente / madrelingua, conoscenza dell'inglese - Domicilio in Svizzera - Iscrizione alla scuola di commercio ## Informazioni aggiuntive In Avaloq abbracciamo la diversità e la differenza. Ci impegniamo con tutto il cuore per le pari opportunità di impiego e promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva in cui i contributi di tutti sono valorizzati e le loro voci ascoltate. Assumiamo, retribuiamo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'orientamento sessuale, dall'identità di genere o da qualsiasi altra affascinante caratteristica che ci rende diversi. Si prega di notare che le nostre descrizioni delle mansioni sono scritte in un linguaggio inclusivo e neutro rispetto al genere. Accettiamo esclusivamente candidature online, preferibilmente con documenti in formato pdf, in italiano o in inglese. Oltre al CV, si prega di allegare alla domanda tutti i certificati della scuola secondaria e una lettera di motivazione.
descriptions.en: Commercial Apprentice AFC Starting from mid-August 2026, we are looking for a Commercial Apprentice AFC at our Bioggio office. During the three years of apprenticeship, we offer you the opportunity to learn various administrative tasks within a leading company in the Swiss market for integrated banking software solutions. Additionally, you will spend 2 days a week at the commercial apprenticeship school and occasionally participate in inter-company courses, where you can acquire further knowledge and skills. Main tasks and responsibilities: - Provide administrative support in various areas, including accounting, human resources, and facility management - Advise clients, suppliers, and employees over the phone or via email - Organize and coordinate meetings and events for various teams - Create and process documents and presentations - Handle and reconcile invoices and payments In each department, you will have a mentor who will take care of you and be ready to help with any questions and provide guidance. If you enjoy working in a team and on a computer, like interacting with people, are reliable and independent, then the commercial apprenticeship at Avaloq is the right path for you. Are you ready for your future at Avaloq? ## Qualifications Necessary requirements: - Good academic performance - Strong interest in economic topics - Adaptability, motivation, independence, and a strong sense of responsibility - Good organizational skills and teamwork orientation - Attention to detail and precision - Fluent/native Italian, knowledge of English - Residency in Switzerland - Enrollment in commercial school ## Additional Information At Avaloq, we embrace diversity and difference. We are wholeheartedly committed to equal employment opportunities and foster an inclusive culture where everyone's contributions are valued and their voices heard. We hire, compensate, and promote regardless of origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other fascinating characteristic that makes us unique. Please note that our job descriptions are written in inclusive and gender-neutral language. We only accept online applications, preferably with documents in pdf format, in Italian or English. In addition to the CV, please attach all secondary school certificates and a motivation letter to the application.
descriptions.de: Kaufmännischer Lernender AFC Ab Mitte August 2026 suchen wir einen kaufmännischen Lernenden AFC an unserem Standort in Bioggio. Während der dreijährigen Lehrzeit bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, verschiedene administrative Aufgaben in einem führenden Unternehmen auf dem Schweizer Markt für integrierte Bankensoftwarelösungen zu erlernen. Außerdem wirst du 2 Tage pro Woche die kaufmännische Berufsschule besuchen und gelegentlich an überbetrieblichen Kursen teilnehmen, wo du weitere Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten erwerben kannst. Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten: - Administrative Unterstützung in verschiedenen Bereichen, einschließlich Buchhaltung, Personalwesen und Facility Management - Beratung von Kunden, Lieferanten und Mitarbeitern telefonisch oder per E-Mail - Organisation und Koordination von Meetings und Veranstaltungen für verschiedene Teams - Erstellung und Bearbeitung von Dokumenten und Präsentationen - Bearbeitung und Abstimmung von Rechnungen und Zahlungen In jeder Abteilung wirst du einen Ansprechpartner haben, der sich um dich kümmert und dir bei Fragen und Anliegen zur Seite steht. Wenn du gerne im Team und am Computer arbeitest, den Kontakt mit Menschen magst, zuverlässig und selbstständig bist, dann ist die kaufmännische Lehre bei Avaloq der richtige Weg für dich. Bist du bereit für deine Zukunft bei Avaloq? ## Qualifikationen Erforderliche Voraussetzungen: - Gute schulische Leistungen - Starkes Interesse an wirtschaftlichen Themen - Anpassungsfähigkeit, Motivation, Selbstständigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein - Gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Teamorientierung - Detailgenauigkeit und Präzision - Fließendes/muttersprachliches Italienisch, Englischkenntnisse - Wohnsitz in der Schweiz - Anmeldung an der kaufmännischen Berufsschule ## Zusätzliche Informationen Bei Avaloq schätzen wir Vielfalt und Unterschiede. Wir setzen uns mit ganzem Herzen für Chancengleichheit ein und fördern eine inklusive Kultur, in der die Beiträge aller geschätzt und ihre Stimmen gehört werden. Wir stellen ein, vergüten und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität oder anderen faszinierenden Merkmalen, die uns einzigartig machen. Bitte beachten Sie, dass unsere Stellenbeschreibungen in inklusiver und geschlechtsneutraler Sprache verfasst sind. Wir akzeptieren ausschließlich Online-Bewerbungen, vorzugsweise mit Dokumenten im PDF-Format, in Italienisch oder Englisch. Neben dem Lebenslauf bitten wir, alle Zeugnisse der Sekundarschule und ein Motivationsschreiben der Bewerbung beizufügen.
descriptions.fr: Apprenti commercial AFC À partir de mi-août 2026, nous recherchons un apprenti commercial AFC pour notre bureau de Bioggio. Pendant les trois années d'apprentissage, nous vous offrons la possibilité d'apprendre diverses tâches administratives au sein d'une entreprise leader sur le marché suisse des solutions logicielles bancaires intégrées. De plus, vous passerez 2 jours par semaine à l'école d'apprentissage commercial et participerez occasionnellement à des cours interentreprises, où vous pourrez acquérir des connaissances et des compétences supplémentaires. Nous nous engageons pleinement en faveur de l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi et promouvons une culture inclusive où les contributions de chacun sont valorisées et leurs voix entendues. Nous recrutons, rémunérons et promouvons indépendamment de l'origine, de l'âge, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'identité de genre ou de toute autre caractéristique fascinante qui nous rend uniques. Nous acceptons uniquement les candidatures en ligne, de préférence avec des documents au format PDF, en italien ou en anglais. En plus du CV, veuillez joindre à votre candidature tous les certificats de l'école secondaire et une lettre de motivation.

## Il ruolo

You will be part of a global team which is responsible for the Trade Processing of different products and their Settlement in the markets.

## Le tue responsabilita

Processing of stock exchange trades (mainly bonds, equities, eft and funds) in Avaloq Banking SuiteSettlement of Delivery and Receive versus payment (DVP and RVP trades)Ensuring that all transactions are processed correctly and settled in a timely mannerMonitoring settlement operations and failed tradesControl actions/coordination with clients, trade departments and custodiansCash and security reconciliationCompliance with Services Level Agreements (SLA) and KPI

## Il tuo profilo

Trade Processing or Settlement experience is a plus, as well as Technology and Solutions skills (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Avaloq Banking Suite, SWIFT)Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handles well during a stressful environmentA service-orientated team player and has a strong motivation to be part of a dynamic teamAn independent and proactive worker with good communication skills

## Informazioni aggiuntive

Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues. We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.Careers

titles.fr: Expert en Reporting Réglementaire Suisse - FiRE

descriptions.it: This role combines Swiss prudential regulation expertise with hands‑on ownership of the FiRE legal reporting platform and business analysis skills to translate regulation into technical requirements.  As a Swiss Regulatory Reporting Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring full and timely compliance with Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory reporting requirements (SNB, FINMA, FMA, Basel IV, liquidity, large exposures, etc.) through the effective use, configuration, and enhancement of the FiRE reporting tool. Your key tasks - Own the end‑to‑end regulatory reporting process in FiRE for SNB statistics, Basel IV capital, liquidity ratios, large exposures, market and country risk, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely submission to the competent authorities - Interpret regulatory texts (FINMA circulars, SNB guidelines, Basel standards) and translate them into clear business rules, data mappings, and technical specifications for implementation in FiRE and upstream systems - Monitor regulatory developments affecting Swiss and cross‑border reporting and assess their impact on existing FiRE configurations, reporting logic, and data requirements; drive or coordinate corresponding change initiatives        FiRE ownership and technical duties - Configure and maintain FiRE (interfaces and client configuration), in close cooperation with IT and the software provider, to reflect current legal requirements and bank‑specific needs - Define, document, and prioritise detailed functional and technical requirements for changes to FiRE and upstream data sources, based on regulatory interpretation and operational constraints - Perform and coordinate functional testing (SIT/UAT) for new FiRE releases and regulatory changes, including non‑regression tests, reconciliation checks, and defect management until production sign‑off        Governance, controls and stakeholders - Design and operate data quality and control frameworks around FiRE (validation checks, reconciliations with general ledger and risk systems, sign‑off workflows), and document procedures in line with internal policies and audit expectations - Act as primary point of contact for internal stakeholders (Finance, Risk, IT, Front Office, Compliance, Legal) on Swiss regulatory reporting topics and for external stakeholders (FINMA, SNB, auditors) regarding FiRE‑generated reports ## Qualifiche - University degree in Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field, with 3–5+ years of experience in banking regulatory reporting or prudential regulation, ideally in the Swiss market - In‑depth knowledge of Swiss prudential and statistical reporting requirements (SNB, FINMA, Basel IV, liquidity, large exposures), and proven ability to interpret and operationalise regulatory texts - Hands‑on experience with regulatory reporting tools, preferably FiRE (or similar solutions), including configuration, data mapping, and testing; strong understanding of banking products (loans, securities, derivatives, off‑balance‑sheet items) - Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with high attention to detail and data quality, and the ability to challenge inconsistencies across systems and reports - Excellent communication skills, capable of drafting clear technical specifications and documentation and of bridging regulatory, business, and IT perspectives - Team‑oriented, proactive, and autonomous working style, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines - Fluency in English plus German or French is preferred for roles in the Swiss banking sector ## Informazioni aggiuntive We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.  In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.  We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.  Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.   #LI-Hybrid

descriptions.de: Diese Position kombiniert Schweizer-Prudenzregulierungs-Expertise mit der praktischen Verantwortung für die rechtliche Berichterstattungspiataform FiRE und Geschäftsanalyseskills, um Regulierungen in technische Anforderungen zu übersetzen. Als Schweizer Regulatorischer Berater bist du verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung vollständiger und pünktlicher Einhaltung der Schweizer und Liechtensteinischen Berichterstattungsanforderungen (SNB, FINMA, FMA, Basel IV, Liquidität, große Auslagen, etc.) durch effektive Nutzung, Konfiguration und Verbesserung der FiRE-Berichtungs-Tool. Deine Hauptaufgaben - Verantwortung für den End-to-End-Regulatorischen Berichterstattungsprozess in FiRE für SNB-Statistiken, Basel IV-Kapital, Liquiditätsverhältnisse, große Auslagen, Markt- und Landrisiken, sicherzustellen, dass die Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und pünktliche Abgabe an die zuständigen Behörden gewährleistet sind - Interpretation der regulatorischen Texte (FINMA-Schaltungen, SNB-Leitlinien, Basel-Standards) und Übersetzung in klare Geschäftsregeln, Datenmappings und technische Spezifikationen für die Implementierung in FiRE und aufwärts Systeme - Überwachung der regulatorischen Entwicklungen, die Schweizer und transnationale Berichterstattung beeinflussen, und Bewertung ihrer Auswirkungen auf die bestehenden FiRE-Konfigurationen, Berichterstattungslogik und Datenanforderungen; Führung oder Koordination der entsprechenden Änderungsinitiativen FiRE-Ownership und technische Aufgaben - Konfiguration und Wartung von FiRE (Interfaces und Kundeneinstellungen), in enger Zusammenarbeit mit IT und dem Softwareanbieter, um die aktuellen rechtlichen Anforderungen und banken-spezifischen Bedürfnisse zu reflektieren - Definition, Dokumentation und Priorisierung der detaillierten funktionalen und technischen Anforderungen für Änderungen an FiRE und aufwärts Datenquellen, basierend auf der regulatorischen Interpretation und operativen Einschränkungen - Durchführung und Koordination funktionaler Tests (SIT/UAT) für neue FiRE-Versionen und regulatorische Änderungen, einschließlich nicht-regressions-Tests, Rekonziliationsprüfungen und Defektmanagement bis zur Produktionsabnahme Governance, Kontrollen und Stakeholder - Design und Betrieb von Datenqualitäts- und Kontrollrahmen um FiRE (Validierungsprüfungen, Rekonziliationen mit dem allgemeinen Buchhaltungs- und Risikosystemen, Abnahmeprozesse), und Dokumentation der Verfahren im Einklang mit internen Richtlinien und Audit-Erwartungen - Funktion als Hauptkontaktpunkt für interne Stakeholder (Finanz, Risiko, IT, Front Office, Compliance, Recht) zu Schweizer regulatorischen Berichterstattungsfragen und für externe Stakeholder (FINMA, SNB, Auditors) bezüglich FiRE-generierter Berichte
descriptions.fr: Cette position combine l'expertise en régulation prudente suisse avec la gestion pratique de la plateforme de reporting légal FiRE et les compétences en analyse d'entreprise pour traduire les régulations en exigences techniques. En tant qu'Expert en Reporting Réglementaire Suisse, vous serez responsable de garantir la conformité complète et à temps avec les exigences de reporting suisse et liechtensteinoises (SNB, FINMA, FMA, Basel IV, liquidité, grandes expositions, etc.) par l'utilisation efficace, la configuration et l'amélioration de l'outil de reporting FiRE. Vos principales tâches - Assurer la gestion complète du processus de reporting réglementaire en FiRE pour les statistiques SNB, le capital Basel IV, les ratios de liquidité, les grandes expositions, les risques de marché et pays, en garantissant l'exactitude, la complétude et la soumission à temps aux autorités compétentes - Interpréter les textes réglementaires (cirulaires FINMA, lignes directrices SNB, normes Basel) et les traduire en règles d'affaires claires, mappages de données et spécifications techniques pour l'implémentation dans FiRE et les systèmes supérieurs - Surveiller les développements réglementaires affectant le reporting suisse et transfrontalier et évaluer leur impact sur les configurations existantes de FiRE, la logique de reporting et les exigences de données; conduire ou coordonner les initiatives de changement correspondantes Gestion FiRE et tâches techniques - Configurer et maintenir FiRE (interfaces et configuration client), en étroite collaboration avec IT et le fournisseur de logiciels, pour refléter les exigences légales actuelles et les besoins spécifiques du banquier - Définir, documenter et prioriser les exigences fonctionnelles et techniques détaillées pour les modifications à FiRE et les sources de données supérieures, basées sur l'interprétation réglementaire et les contraintes opérationnelles - Effectuer et coordonner les tests fonctionnels (SIT/UAT) pour les nouvelles versions de FiRE et les modifications réglementaires, y compris les tests de non-régression, les vérifications de réconciliation et la gestion des défauts jusqu'à l'approbation de production Governance, contrôles et parties prenantes - Concevoir et exploiter les cadres de qualité des données et de contrôle autour de FiRE (contrôles de validation, réconciliations avec le grand livre et les systèmes de risque, workflows d'approbation), et documenter les procédures en ligne avec les politiques internes et les attentes d'audit - Agir comme le point de contact principal pour les parties prenantes internes (Finance, Risque, IT, Front Office, Conformité, Droit) sur les questions de reporting réglementaire suisse et pour les parties prenantes externes (FINMA, SNB, auditeurs) concernant les rapports générés par FiRE

descriptions.it:
The Operation Center Specialist is responsible for monitoring and maintaining the health and performance of our IT systems and batch processing jobs.
This role is crucial in ensuring the smooth operation of our IT infrastructure and applications, and the timely execution of critical business processes.
Your key tasks
- System Monitoring: - Proactively monitor system performance and availability metrics
- Identify and troubleshoot system anomalies and performance bottlenecks
- Respond to system alerts and alarms in a timely and efficient manner
- Escalate critical issues to appropriate technical teams

- Batch Processing: - Schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot batch jobs
- Ensure the timely and accurate execution of batch processes
- Investigate and resolve batch job failures

- Incident Management: - Document and track incidents in accordance with established procedures
- Ensure the engagement of all required teams to resolve incidents

Given that our work involves handling data in Switzerland,  we require applicants to be Swiss residents .

## Qualifiche

- Good understanding of IT infrastructure components (servers, networks, databases)
- Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Ability to work independently and in a team environment
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with a good level of fluency in English
- Full availability to work in shifts, including nights, weekends and public holidays
It would be a real bonus if you have 
- Experience with system monitoring tools (e.g. PagerDuty, NetCool, Grafana)
- Knowledge of batch processing concepts and tools (e.g. Zena)
- Experience with ITIL frameworks
- Knowledge of cloud technologies

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. 
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. 
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. 
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

titles.en: Head of Quality Assurance & Client Onboarding

descriptions.it:
This is a fantastic opportunity for a Head of Quality Assurance & Client Onboarding to join our newly established Service Operations organization at Avaloq.
This role offers significant exposure to a diverse range of clients, including some of the world’s leading financial institutions—an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to advance their career in an exciting and client‑focused environment.
In this role you will carry two core responsibilities. First, you will lead, coordinate and oversee end‑to‑end testing activities, to ensure quality and consistency of Service Operations test campaigns. Then, you will ensure a seamless client onboarding journey by leading the team responsible for Transition & Transformation within Service Operations.
In addition, you will serve as the primary point of contact for the Avaloq Sales organization on Service Operations topics, and support Avaloq’s client community through consultancy engagements.
Your key tasks
Quality Assurance Leadership
- Lead and develop the Service Operations Test and Quality Assurance Managers.
- Partner with Project Delivery, Service Operations and Development teams to design testing strategies, coordinate defect management and ensure cohesive delivery.
- Support the setup of test environments, engaging the appropriate technical teams.
- Ensure successful and comprehensive test campaigns; analyze defect results; provide clear reporting, including quality indicators, to stakeholders.
- Drive continuous improvement and the design of sustainable testing methodologies across customer test campaigns.
Client Onboarding
- Lead the Service Operations Client Onboarding team.
- Establish and maintain effective project structures, governance models and stakeholder management practices.
- Oversee end to end Transition & Transformation project execution for Service Operations.
- Organize and lead consultancy projects for Avaloq clients across on‑premises, SaaS and Banking‑Operations‑as‑a‑Service models for Service Operations.
- Represent Avaloq in client and prospect workshops
Leadership & Team Development
- Provide ongoing guidance, coaching and feedback to team members to foster a culture of learning, growth and continuous improvement.
 

## Qualifiche

- 8+ years of experience in a similar role within the financial industry, ideally in roles involving cross‑functional collaboration and transformation
- Proven leadership skills, including team motivation, performance management, and career development, where you use your exceptional interpersonal skills and communication skills in English (written and verbal) todemonstrate a high level of empathy when engaging with clients and internal stakeholders
- Strong project management and change management experince, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, prioritize effectively, and deliver results
- University degree or equivalent qualification
- Expertise in test management methodologies, with a track record of driving cross‑functional transformation initiatives
- Technical proficiency in JIRA and strong command of the Microsoft Office Suite
It would be a real bonus if you have:
- Client facing experience
- Project management track record
- Test Automation experience and associated tools
- Good knowledge of Banking services, Application Management Support and Cloud & Infrastructure
- Working experience with Avaloq project/product
- German, Italian and French knowledge is a plus 

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

descriptions.en: This is a fantastic opportunity to join Avaloq in a Senior Project Manager role, where you will get the opportunity to manage projects within our global CTO organization, supporting the build and roll-out of new product functionalities or components, to our market-leading clients. descriptions.fr: C'est une opportunité fantastique de rejoindre Avaloq en tant que Senior Project Manager, où vous aurez l'opportunité de gérer des projets au sein de notre organisation mondiale CTO, en soutenant la construction et le déploiement de nouvelles fonctionnalités ou composants de produits pour nos clients leaders du marché. en garantissant que les délais sont respectés conformément au calendrier du projet - Diriger des équipes de projet transversales / fonctionnelles pour atteindre les objectifs et les jalons du projet - descriptions.it: Il ruolo Gestione del Portafoglio Gestire e supervisionare i portafogli di consegna dei progetti per la regione Europa, garantendo trasparenza, coerenza e controllo finanziario su tutti i progetti Gestire, revisionare e verificare le previsioni finanziarie per tutti i progetti nei portafogli regionali, garantendo precisione e allineamento con i budget approvati Coordinare e guidare cicli regolari di aggiornamento delle previsioni, inclusi richieste formali e follow-up con i responsabili dei programmi e i KAM Preparare e guidare riunioni di revisione dedicate con i responsabili dei programmi, i KAM e i controllori finanziari per valutare le prospettive dei progetti, l'evoluzione delle previsioni rispetto al budget e lo stato delle fatture e dei contratti Garantire l'allineamento tra i dati di Jira e le previsioni finanziarie, identificando discrepanze e promuovendo azioni correttive dove necessario Definire, preparare e mantenere report regionali per: - Riunioni di stato regionale con il responsabile della consegna - Riunioni mensili di consegna e revisione finanziaria con i dirigenti regionali e di consegna e il controllo finanziario Contribuire all'identificazione, valutazione e reporting dei rischi di consegna per la regione Europa, fornendo input al Comitato dei Rischi Verificare il processo di richieste esterne Verificare la qualità del contenuto del PSR (Project Status Report) prima di qualsiasi riunione settimanale di stato del progetto Standard di Consegna Definire e mantenere gli standard di consegna dei progetti, inclusi processi, modelli e strumenti, per garantire modi di lavoro armonizzati nell'organizzazione. Questo include progettare e documentare nuovi processi utilizzando BPMN, sfruttando una conoscenza approfondita dei processi interni di Avaloq e affrontando proattivamente punti aperti coordinandosi e allineandosi con tutti gli stakeholder rilevanti coinvolti nelle rispettive attività Aggiornare e mantenere il GIM e Adonis in linea con gli standard di consegna definiti Guidare e gestire la comunicazione aziendale relativa a nuovi o aggiornati standard di consegna, garantendo chiarezza e adozione in tutte le regioni e funzioni Partecipare attivamente alla Terminology and Policy Board, contribuendo alla definizione, allineamento e governance degli standard e politiche di consegna ## Il tuo profilo Formazione & Certificazioni Formazione accademica: Laurea magistrale in Amministrazione aziendale, Finanza, Ingegneria gestionale o settore correlato Certificazioni professionali: PMP (Project Management Professional), PfMP (Portfolio Management Professional) o Prince2 Practitioner sono fortemente desiderabili Metodologia: Formazione formale o certificazione in BPMN 2.0 (Business Process Model and Notation) Esperienza professionale Gestione del Portafoglio: 5–8 anni di esperienza nella gestione del portafoglio progetti (PPM) o leadership PMO in un'organizzazione di grandi dimensioni e internazionale Coesione finanziaria: Provenienza nel controllo finanziario, gestione del budget e previsioni progettuali. Devi essere in grado di "sfidare" dati finanziari e report di varianza Esperto del settore: Conoscenza approfondita dei processi interni di Avaloq è un vantaggio significativo (o obbligatorio, a seconda della tua priorità) Gestione degli stakeholder: Ampia esperienza nella coordinazione e influenza della Direzione, dei responsabili dei programmi e dei controllori finanziari Competenze tecniche Strumenti per i progetti: Elevata padronanza di Jira (incluso Portfolio/Advanced Roadmaps) e Confluence Modellazione dei processi: Esperienza pratica con Adonis, Signavio o strumenti simili per BPM per documentare e mantenere gli standard di consegna Dati & Reporting: Elevate competenze in Excel (Power Query, Tabelle pivot) ed esperienza con strumenti BI (es. PowerBI, Tableau) per il reporting regionale Metodologie: Buona conoscenza sia delle metodologie Waterfall che Agile Soft Skills & Competenze Precisione analitica: Eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli con la capacità di riconciliare discrepanze tra dati operativi (Jira) e previsioni finanziarie Comunicazione eccellente: Capacità di articolare cambiamenti complessi ai processi e agli standard di consegna in modo chiaro a diversi pubblici in diverse regioni Orientamento alla qualità: Una mentalità "zero difetti" riguardo alla qualità dei report di stato dei progetti (PSR) e della documentazione Lingue: Proficienza professionale completa in inglese è richiesta. La padronanza del tedesco è un vantaggio significativo per la regione europea ## Informazioni aggiuntive Riconosciamo che gestire il bilancio tra vita lavorativa e personale è una sfida che affrontiamo tutti quotidianamente e per supportarvi siamo lieti di offrire lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere un equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata e continuare la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali. In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e di comprendere che il successo del nostro business si basa sul potere delle opinioni diverse, siamo totalmente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente di uguaglianza e una cultura inclusiva dove puoi essere la tua autentica versione. Assumiamo, retribuiamo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, età, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale o qualsiasi altra fantastica caratteristica che ci rende unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per redigere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro. Si prega di notare che non accetteremo CV speculativi per qualsiasi nostro ruolo da parte di agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi candidatura non richiesta sarà esente da qualsiasi aspettativa di pagamento. #LI-Hybrid Benefit Bonus annuale In Avaloq lavoriamo duramente per rimanere un fornitore leader nel settore e amiamo premiare i nostri colleghi con una parte del nostro successo attraverso un bonus annuale, rimarrai addirittura eleggibile al bonus annuale mentre svolgi il lavoro più difficile della tua vita – prenderti cura dei tuoi figli durante le ferie parentali. Lavoro flessibile Capiamo che adattare la tua vita al lavoro può essere impegnativo, motivo per cui nella maggior parte dei ruoli offriamo lavoro flessibile per permetterti di prosperare sia nel lavoro che al di fuori di esso. Riconoscimento immediato Amiamo vedere le persone che prosperano nei loro ruoli e abbiamo uno schema di riconoscimento immediato in Avaloq per aiutare i manager a premiare il grande lavoro svolto dai nostri colleghi con un regalo per ringraziarli. Accesso a Udemy per apprendimento professionale e personale Pensiamo che sia importante imparare e crescere professionalmente, ma se sei qualcuno che ama imparare al di fuori del lavoro ti diamo accesso all'apprendimento online sia per scopi professionali che personali, con oltre 210.000 corsi a tua disposizione. Chi siamo Fondata e con sede in Svizzera, Avaloq sta continuamente espandendo la sua presenza globale con circa 2.500 colleghi in 12 paesi e più di 160 clienti in 35 paesi.
