descriptions.en: Join Avaloq’s Network team in Cloud & Infrastructure Operations. You will be tasked with ensuring secure, reliable connectivity and network operations. This includes managing connections and networks between and within our data centres, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), our customers, and other related services. You will combine operational discipline with hands-on engineering and automation. This will help improve the current setup in a regulated environment. Operational discipline includes stability, handling incidents, and hardening. Your key tasks • Run and operate hybrid connectivity spanning enterprise LAN/WAN, data centres and OCI—ensuring high availability, predictable performance, and robust security controls. • Continuously improve and streamline the network platform. Standardise designs. Remove complexity. Improve endurance. Reduce operational toil. Use automation tools like Terraform and GitOps to achieve these goals. • Handle network operations. Monitor the network. Respond to incidents. Troubleshoot issues. Manage problems. Drive root-cause analysis. Take preventive actions. • Collaborate with the Architecture and Sales teams to obtain scalable, secure network designs for implementation and improvement roadmaps. • Keep operational documents high-quality. This includes runbooks, standards, and diagrams. Make sure services are ready by following good change practices, testing methods, and giving clear handovers. ## Qualifiche • Minimum 5 years of experience in network engineering. This experience must include working in complex enterprise environments. • Skills in routing and switching, WAN and Internet connectivity, firewalls, and load balancing. • A solid insight into hybrid-cloud networking is required. This includes experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). • An Infrastructure-as-Code mindset. Useful experience with Terraform, whether by creating or using modules, and be familiar with Git for change control and collaboration. • Solid fundamentals: TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, VLANs, subnetting, VPN/IPsec; deep troubleshooting skills across layers (L2–L7). • Operational excellence while prioritising security: monitoring, managing incidents and problems, and creating clear documentation. • Experience in enhancing endurance in regulated or high-availability environments, like financial services. It would be a real bonus if you have • Certifications such as CCNP, OCI Networking (Associate or Professional), CheckPoint CCSE, FortiGate FCP, and Terraform Associate. • Experience with SD-WAN How you work • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and collaborate well in cross-functional teams. • You are curious and pragmatic: eager to learn, but focused on delivering secure, maintainable solutions. • You stay structured under tension and can prioritise appropriately during incidents and delivery peaks. • Languages: fluent English; Italian and/or German are a plus. • Shift work and/or on-call duty apply depending on service needs. • Job Location: Bioggio (TI), Switzerland • For regulatory reasons, Swiss residency is required If you enjoy operating mission-critical networks and modernising them through automation and cloud adoption (OCI), we’d like to hear from you. ## Informazioni aggiuntive We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. Dazu gehören die Verwaltung von Verbindungen und Netzwerken zwischen und innerhalb unserer Rechenzentren, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), unsere Kunden und andere damit verbundene Dienstleistungen. Sie kombinieren die operative Disziplin mit Hand-on-Engineering und Automatisierung. Dadurch wird die aktuelle Einrichtung in einer geregelten Umgebung verbessert. Die operative Disziplin umfasst Stabilität, Handhabungsvorfälle und Aushärtung. Ihre zentralen Aufgaben • Führen und betreiben Sie die Hybrid-Konnektivität, die das Unternehmen LAN/WAN, Rechenzentren und OCI umfasst – gewährleisten Sie hohe Verfügbarkeit, vorhersehbare Leistung und robuste Sicherheitssteuerungen. • Die Netzwerkplattform wird kontinuierlich verbessert und optimiert. In Avaloq sind wir stolz darauf, Vielfalt zu akzeptieren und zu verstehen, dass der Erfolg unseres Unternehmens auf der Macht verschiedener Meinungen aufgebaut ist, sind wir ganz herzlich dazu verpflichtet, eine Chancengleichheitsumgebung und inklusive Kultur zu fördern, in der Sie Ihr wahres authentisches Selbst sein können. Wir mieten, kompensieren und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder anderen fantastischen Eigenschaften, die uns alle einzigartig machen, haben wir unser Bestes getan, um diese Anzeige in inklusive und neutral zu schreiben. descriptions.fr: Rejoignez l'équipe d'Avaloqs Network dans Cloud & Infrastructure Operations. Vous serez chargé d'assurer une connectivité et des opérations réseau sûres et fiables. Cela comprend la gestion des connexions et des réseaux entre nos centres de données et au sein de ceux-ci, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), nos clients et d'autres services connexes. Vous combinerez la discipline opérationnelle avec l'ingénierie pratique et l'automatisation. Cela aidera à améliorer la configuration actuelle dans un environnement réglementé. La discipline opérationnelle comprend la stabilité, la manipulation des incidents et le durcissement. Vos tâches clés • Exécutez et exploitez une connectivité hybride couvrant l'entreprise LAN/WAN, les centres de données et OCI – assurant une grande disponibilité, des performances prévisibles et des contrôles de sécurité robustes. • Améliorer et rationaliser en permanence la plate-forme réseau. Normaliser les conceptions. Supprimer la complexité. Améliorer l'endurance. Réduire le travail opérationnel. Utilisez des outils d'automatisation comme Terraform et GitOps pour atteindre ces objectifs. • Gérer les opérations du réseau. Surveillez le réseau. Répondez aux incidents. Problème. Gérer les problèmes. Conduisez l'analyse des causes profondes. Prendre des mesures préventives. • Collaborer avec les équipes Architecture et Ventes pour obtenir des conceptions de réseau évolutives et sécurisées pour la mise en œuvre et l'amélioration des feuilles de route. • Conserver des documents opérationnels de haute qualité. Cela comprend les runbooks, les standards et les diagrammes. Assurez-vous que les services sont prêts en suivant de bonnes pratiques de changement, en testant les méthodes et en donnant des transferts clairs. ## Qualifiche • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie de réseau. Cette expérience doit inclure le travail dans des environnements d'entreprise complexes. • Compétences en routage et commutation, connectivité WAN et Internet, pare-feu et équilibrage des charges. • Il est nécessaire d'avoir une bonne idée du réseau hybride-cloud. Cela inclut l'expérience avec Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). • Un état d'esprit d'infrastructure en tant que code. Expérience utile avec Terraform, en créant ou en utilisant des modules, et être familier avec Git pour le contrôle du changement et la collaboration. • Fondements solides: TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, VLAN, sous-netting, VPN/IPsec; compétences de dépannage profond à travers les couches (L2–L7). • L'excellence opérationnelle tout en accordant la priorité à la sécurité : suivi, gestion des incidents et des problèmes et création de documents clairs. • Expérience dans le renforcement de l'endurance dans les environnements réglementés ou à forte disponibilité, comme les services financiers. Ce serait un vrai bonus si vous avez • Certifications telles que CCNP, OCI Networking (Associate ou Professional), CheckPoint CCSE, FortiGate FCP, et Terraform Associate. • Expérience avec SD-WAN Comment vous travaillez • Vous communiquez clairement avec les intervenants techniques et non techniques et collaborez bien dans des équipes interfonctionnelles. • Vous êtes curieux et pragmatique : désireux d'apprendre, mais concentré sur la fourniture de solutions sûres et durables. • Vous restez structuré sous tension et pouvez prioriser adéquatement pendant les incidents et les pics d'accouchement. • Langues: anglais couramment; italien et/ou allemand sont un plus. • Le travail posté et/ou le service de garde s'appliquent en fonction des besoins du service. • Lieu d'emploi: Bioggio (TI), Suisse • Pour des raisons réglementaires, la résidence suisse est requise Si vous aimez exploiter des réseaux critiques pour la mission et les moderniser grâce à l'automatisation et à l'adoption du cloud (OCI), nous aimerions avoir de vos nouvelles. Information complémentaire Nous nous rendons compte que la gestion de l'équilibre de vie au travail est un défi auquel nous sommes tous confrontés dans notre vie quotidienne et pour soutenir avec cela nous sommes heureux d'offrir un travail hybride et flexible pour la plupart de nos Avaloqers pour maintenir l'équilibre de vie au travail et pour continuer notre fantastique culture Avaloq dans nos bureaux mondiaux. À Avaloq, nous sommes fiers d'embrasser la diversité et de comprendre que le succès de notre entreprise est fondé sur la puissance des différentes opinions, nous sommes tout à fait engagés à favoriser un environnement d'égalité des chances et une culture inclusive où vous pouvez être votre véritable soi authentique. Nous recrutons, compensons et promouvons indépendamment de l'origine, de l'âge, de l'identité de genre, de l'orientation sexuelle ou de tout autre caractère fantastique qui nous rend uniques, nous avons fait de notre mieux pour écrire cette annonce de manière inclusive et neutre. Veuillez noter que nous n'accepterons aucune soumission de CV spéculative pour l'un de nos rôles des agences de recrutement, et toute soumission non sollicitée sera exemptée de toute attente de paiement. #LI-Hybrid

descriptions.it:
This is an exciting opportunity for a client‑focused Solution Consultant to join our Switzerland office and play a key role in driving Avaloq’s growth across European and Swiss markets. Working at the intersection of sales, product, and delivery, you will engage with leading financial institutions to understand their strategic challenges, shape tailored solutions, and position Avaloq as a trusted long‑term partner.
Your key tasks:

• Drive solution consulting activities across the full sales cycle, from early discovery through solution design and handover to delivery.

• Lead solution shaping and requirements consolidation, translating complex business needs into compelling and feasible solution proposals.

• Design and deliver impactful client engagements (presentations, demos, workshops), clearly articulating Avaloq’s value proposition to senior stakeholders and decision‑makers.

• Own and coordinate RFI / RFP processes, ensuring high‑quality, consistent, and competitive responses aligned with client expectations.

• Collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams (Sales, Product, Architecture, Pricing, Delivery) to ensure alignment between client needs and Avaloq capabilities.

• Ensure clear documentation and communication of solution scope, supporting transparency from pre‑sales through implementation.

## Qualifiche

• Fluency in German (C1/C2) is mandatory.

• Proven track record in Solution Consulting, Pre‑Sales or Sales Engineering, ideally within banking, wealth management, or fintech.

• Strong ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-level (incl. C‑level).

• Experience working in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments across regions

• Willingness to travel across Europe.
It would be a real bonus if you have:

• Experience working in Financial Services, FinTech or Consulting industries

• A technical background in Software Engineering or related discipline

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. 
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. 
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. 
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

descriptions.it:
Avaloq is seeking an experienced Technical Solution Consultant to join the Global Solutions Consulting organisation.

The role is responsible for end‑to‑end solution design, commercial support and RFP/RFI execution for complex banking opportunities across private banking, wealth management and universal banking clients.
The successful candidate will act as a trusted technical and solution advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, owning solution integrity across functional, technical, commercial and delivery dimensions.
Your key tasks 
Sales & Client Engagement

• Act as a customer‑facing solution authority supporting Avaloq sales opportunities primarily within Europe and North America.  Involvement in other regions may be necessary when requried.

• Lead or contribute to client workshops, solution presentations and due‑diligence sessions, both remote and on‑site.

• Translate client business, regulatory and IT requirements into viable Avaloq‑based solution architectures.

• Act as a trusted advisor for senior client stakeholders, including CIO, COO, Head of Operations and Enterprise Architecture.
RFP, RFI & Deal Support

• Manage and deliver RFP / RFI / Technical Questionnaire responses with high quality, consistency and regulatory defensibility.

• Own solution positioning, differentiators and assumptions, ensuring clarity between standard, configurable and custom capabilities.

• Prepare deal gate material (solution scope, complexity, risks, assumptions, cost drivers) in alignment with Sales and Delivery.

• Ensure all solution proposals comply with Avaloq commercial, legal, risk and governance frameworks.
Solution Architecture & Design

• Design end‑to‑end solutions covering:
• Avaloq Core Platform (ACP)

• Digital Channels (Web / RM Workplace)

• Community API, integration and messaging patterns

• Data, analytics, reporting and regulatory tooling

• Hosting models: SaaS, BPaaS, managed services, on‑premises / client‑hosted


• Define non‑functional requirements including:
• Security, IAM, data protection and regulatory compliance

• High availability, DR, performance and scalability

• Operational model, support and change processes


• Partner closely with Delivery, Product Management, Hosting and Security teams to ensure solution feasibility and integrity.
Internal Stakeholder Management

• Act as primary solution Point-of-Contact for internal deal‑making teams, coordinating input from Product, Architecture, Security, Legal and Delivery.

• Manage internal alignments, reviews and approvals, ensuring auditability and traceability of decisions.

• Follow and enforce internal processes, governance and handover disciplines to Delivery.

## Qualifiche

Domain & Industry

• Strong experience in private banking, wealth management or financial services IT.

• Solid understanding of banking operations, regulatory environments (e.g. FINMA, ECB, MAS, FCA) and IT controls.
Technology Expertise
The candidate must demonstrate hands‑on experience with technologies commonly used within Avaloq solutions, including:

• Core banking platforms (Avaloq or comparable tier‑1 systems)

• API‑based integration, messaging and event‑driven architectures

• Digital banking channels and client‑facing platforms

• Cloud and hosting concepts (OCI, AWS, Azure, hybrid models)

• Strong understanding of Kubernetes including:
• Container orchestration concepts, networking and security

• High availability, resilience and scaling patterns

• Operational concerns: monitoring, logging, upgrades and lifecycle management


• Experience positioning and designing solutions running on:
• Managed Kubernetes services (e.g. OpenShift, EKS, AKS or equivalent)

• Hybrid or on‑premises Kubernetes environments


• Ability to articulate Kubernetes value propositions, risks and operational implications clearly to clients and non‑technical stakeholders.

• Security architecture, IAM, data protection and compliance controls

• Infrastructure sizing, performance and high‑availability design

• Modern enterprise technologies (Kubernetes, containerisation, observability, CI/CD)
Professional Skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, suitable for C‑suite, regulators and client decision‑makers.

• Strong presentation and storytelling ability, translating complexity into clear, defensible narratives.

• Proven ability to manage multiple parallel engagements under time pressure.

• High level of autonomy, accountability and professionalism.

• Ability to operate confidently in ambiguous, high‑stakes deal environments.
Education & Experience

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent experience.

• Typically 7–10+ years experience in solution consulting, pre‑sales or architecture roles.

• Prior experience working in international, matrix‑organised environments is strongly preferred.
Language & Cultural Capability

• Fluent English is mandatory; additional European languages are strongly preferred, particularly:
• German (highly desirable for Swiss and DACH clients)

• French (Switzerland / France / Benelux)

• Italian or Spanish (southern Europe coverage)


• Ability to operate comfortably in multilingual, multicultural client environments, including adapting communication style for different regions.

• Experience working with regulated European financial institutions is a strong advantage.

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. 
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. 
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. 
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

The role is responsible for end‑to‑end solution design, commercial support and RFP/RFI execution for complex banking opportunities across private banking, wealth management and universal banking clients.
The successful candidate will act as a trusted technical and solution advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, owning solution integrity across functional, technical, commercial and delivery dimensions.
Your key tasks 
Sales & Client Engagement

• Act as a customer‑facing solution authority supporting Avaloq sales opportunities primarily within Europe and North America.  Involvement in other regions may be necessary when requried.

• Lead or contribute to client workshops, solution presentations and due‑diligence sessions, both remote and on‑site.

• Translate client business, regulatory and IT requirements into viable Avaloq‑based solution architectures.

• Act as a trusted advisor for senior client stakeholders, including CIO, COO, Head of Operations and Enterprise Architecture.
RFP, RFI & Deal Support

• Manage and deliver RFP / RFI / Technical Questionnaire responses with high quality, consistency and regulatory defensibility.

• Own solution positioning, differentiators and assumptions, ensuring clarity between standard, configurable and custom capabilities.

• Prepare deal gate material (solution scope, complexity, risks, assumptions, cost drivers) in alignment with Sales and Delivery.

• Ensure all solution proposals comply with Avaloq commercial, legal, risk and governance frameworks.
Solution Architecture & Design

• Design end‑to‑end solutions covering:
• Avaloq Core Platform (ACP)

• Digital Channels (Web / RM Workplace)

• Community API, integration and messaging patterns

• Data, analytics, reporting and regulatory tooling

• Hosting models: SaaS, BPaaS, managed services, on‑premises / client‑hosted


• Define non‑functional requirements including:
• Security, IAM, data protection and regulatory compliance

• High availability, DR, performance and scalability

• Operational model, support and change processes


• Partner closely with Delivery, Product Management, Hosting and Security teams to ensure solution feasibility and integrity.
Internal Stakeholder Management

• Act as primary solution Point-of-Contact for internal deal‑making teams, coordinating input from Product, Architecture, Security, Legal and Delivery.

• Manage internal alignments, reviews and approvals, ensuring auditability and traceability of decisions.

• Follow and enforce internal processes, governance and handover disciplines to Delivery.

## Qualifiche

Domain & Industry

• Strong experience in private banking, wealth management or financial services IT.

• Solid understanding of banking operations, regulatory environments (e.g. FINMA, ECB, MAS, FCA) and IT controls.
Technology Expertise
The candidate must demonstrate hands‑on experience with technologies commonly used within Avaloq solutions, including:

• Core banking platforms (Avaloq or comparable tier‑1 systems)

• API‑based integration, messaging and event‑driven architectures

• Digital banking channels and client‑facing platforms

• Cloud and hosting concepts (OCI, AWS, Azure, hybrid models)

• Strong understanding of Kubernetes including:
• Container orchestration concepts, networking and security

• High availability, resilience and scaling patterns

• Operational concerns: monitoring, logging, upgrades and lifecycle management


• Experience positioning and designing solutions running on:
• Managed Kubernetes services (e.g. OpenShift, EKS, AKS or equivalent)

• Hybrid or on‑premises Kubernetes environments


• Ability to articulate Kubernetes value propositions, risks and operational implications clearly to clients and non‑technical stakeholders.

• Security architecture, IAM, data protection and compliance controls

• Infrastructure sizing, performance and high‑availability design

• Modern enterprise technologies (Kubernetes, containerisation, observability, CI/CD)
Professional Skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, suitable for C‑suite, regulators and client decision‑makers.

• Strong presentation and storytelling ability, translating complexity into clear, defensible narratives.

• Proven ability to manage multiple parallel engagements under time pressure.

• High level of autonomy, accountability and professionalism.

• Ability to operate confidently in ambiguous, high‑stakes deal environments.
Education & Experience

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent experience.

• Typically 7–10+ years experience in solution consulting, pre‑sales or architecture roles.

• Prior experience working in international, matrix‑organised environments is strongly preferred.
Language & Cultural Capability

• Fluent English is mandatory; additional European languages are strongly preferred, particularly:
• German (highly desirable for Swiss and DACH clients)

• French (Switzerland / France / Benelux)

• Italian or Spanish (southern Europe coverage)


• Ability to operate comfortably in multilingual, multicultural client environments, including adapting communication style for different regions.

• Experience working with regulated European financial institutions is a strong advantage.

descriptions.it:
As a member of the Avaloq development team, you will be part of a group of highly skilled, motivated and dynamic people that are responsible for a central part of the Avaloq Banking Suite. You will design, implement, maintain and test innovative software solutions to meet the client's needs. You will be working as a Mid or Senior Level Developer in an environment where formal and on-the-job training is a priority, and you will learn a lot.

The Avaloq Banking Suite is one of the largest PL/SQL applications in the world. It is safe to say that your co-workers are among, if not the most knowledgeable Oracle specialists in the world. Development takes place in our integrated development environment - a customized Eclipse platform, which is tightly integrated with a build automation and delivery system, allowing a standardized and automated process to be followed.
Your key tasks

• Develop and implement new features based on internal and external requirements

• Understand the Avaloq Core Banking Platform and the corresponding business areas

• Lead projects from Analysis requirement to implementation and testing phase with client facing interactions

• Perform maintenance work such as: root cause analysis, bug fixing, code optimizations

• Provide technical assistance for customers or business analysts. Closely collaborate with the Product Owner, Scrum Master and other Software Engineer

## Qualifiche

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent

• Must have at least four years of work experience in a software developer role

• Knowledge and experience in RDBMS, Oracle SQL, Oracle PL/SQL

• Good understanding of scrum agile methodologies

• Excellent analytical skills and systematic approach to problem solving

• Quality-conscious attitude, self-motivated and goal-oriented

• Open-minded, good team player, and has good communication skills (proficient in English verbally and in writing) which allow to have also a smooth client interaction during the phases of projects
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Experience in one or more high level programming language

• Experience with AWS

• Knowledge in Oracle Database architecture

descriptions.it:
As the Head of Strategic Finance Projects , you will play a key role in reshaping our global finance operations. You will connect Finance, IT, and broader business teams to ensure that our systems not only meet current needs but also bolster our future growth and efficiency. Beyond the primary ERP consolidation and advancement, you will drive other strategic initiatives vital for Avaloq's overall success.
Key Tasks:
Project Management excellence

• Establish a robust project management structure for Finance. Implement industry-standard methodologies to ensure consistent delivery across the portfolio.

• Develop detailed project plans to ensure all milestones are met on schedule and within budget. Track performance, implement corrective actions and conduct rigorous post-project evaluations .

• Independently execute key projects with a global team and an optimized resource allocation, always in best quality, time and budget

• Architect and lead the end-to-end project lifecycle for consolidating two legacy on-prem systems into a single, cohesive cloud-based solution.
The change agent: Modernity & efficiency

• Act as a tireless change agent, leading the Finance function out of legacy constraints and into a modern, automated, and scalable digital environment.

• Champion the "simplification first" principle. Before automating, you will challenge existing complexities to ensure we are building lean, efficient processes rather than just digitizing old ones.

• Ensure that new systems deliver systems that provide real-time insights, allowing Finance to act as a strategic advisor to the wider business.

• Foster a culture within the Finance organization that embraces industry-standard technology and continuous improvement.
Leadership and stakeholder engagement

• Lead and mentor the strategic projects team to boost performance and professional growth.; encourage innovative thinking and problem-solving within the Finance organization.

• Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders, gathering feedback and leading meetings to promote transparency and set clear expectations.

• Develop and execute communication plans to keep the organization engaged and provide training to ensure smooth adoption of new systems.
 

## Qualifiche

• Strong proven track record of working in a similar role, ideally within a banking software provider

• You will have strong experience of ERP platforms, e.g., SAP, including implementations, upgrades and finance modules. 

• Strong proven ability to lead complex cross-functional projects where you manage the timelines, budget, risks and stakeholder engagement using your fantastic communication and drive. 

• You will have evidence of leading at least one full ERP migration to the cloud for the full project life-cyle.

• You will have strong conceptual thinking skills and be proficient in data analysis and visualisation, but equally capable of explaining these complex concepts in an easy-to-understand way to those that dont. 

## Informazioni aggiuntive

• Independently execute key projects with a global team and an optimized resource allocation, always in best quality, time and budget

• Architect and lead the end-to-end project lifecycle for consolidating two legacy on-prem systems into a single, cohesive cloud-based solution.
The change agent: Modernity & efficiency

• Act as a tireless change agent, leading the Finance function out of legacy constraints and into a modern, automated, and scalable digital environment.

• Champion the "simplification first" principle. Before automating, you will challenge existing complexities to ensure we are building lean, efficient processes rather than just digitizing old ones.

• Ensure that new systems deliver systems that provide real-time insights, allowing Finance to act as a strategic advisor to the wider business.

• Foster a culture within the Finance organization that embraces industry-standard technology and continuous improvement.
Leadership and stakeholder engagement

• Lead and mentor the strategic projects team to boost performance and professional growth.; encourage innovative thinking and problem-solving within the Finance organization.

• Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders, gathering feedback and leading meetings to promote transparency and set clear expectations.

• Develop and execute communication plans to keep the organization engaged and provide training to ensure smooth adoption of new systems.
 

## Qualifiche

• Strong proven track record of working in a similar role, ideally within a banking software provider

• You will have strong experience of ERP platforms, e.g., SAP, including implementations, upgrades and finance modules. 

• Strong proven ability to lead complex cross-functional projects where you manage the timelines, budget, risks and stakeholder engagement using your fantastic communication and drive. 

• You will have evidence of leading at least one full ERP migration to the cloud for the full project life-cyle.

• You will have strong conceptual thinking skills and be proficient in data analysis and visualisation, but equally capable of explaining these complex concepts in an easy-to-understand way to those that dont.

descriptions.en: Join Avaloq’s Network team in Cloud & Infrastructure Operations. You will be tasked with ensuring secure, reliable connectivity and network operations. This includes managing connections and networks between and within our data centres, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), our customers, and other related services. You will combine operational discipline with hands-on engineering and automation. This will help improve the current setup in a regulated environment. Operational discipline includes stability, handling incidents, and hardening. Your key tasks • Run and operate hybrid connectivity spanning enterprise LAN/WAN, data centres and OCI—ensuring high availability, predictable performance, and robust security controls. • Continuously improve and streamline the network platform. Standardise designs. Remove complexity. Improve endurance. Reduce operational toil. Use automation tools like Terraform and GitOps to achieve these goals. • Handle network operations. Monitor the network. Respond to incidents. Troubleshoot issues. Manage problems. Drive root-cause analysis. Take preventive actions. • Collaborate with the Architecture and Sales teams to obtain scalable, secure network designs for implementation and improvement roadmaps. • Keep operational documents high-quality. This includes runbooks, standards, and diagrams. Make sure services are ready by following good change practices, testing methods, and giving clear handovers. ## Qualifiche • Minimum 5 years of experience in network engineering. This experience must include working in complex enterprise environments. • Skills in routing and switching, WAN and Internet connectivity, firewalls, and load balancing. • A solid insight into hybrid-cloud networking is required. This includes experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). • An Infrastructure-as-Code mindset. Useful experience with Terraform, whether by creating or using modules, and be familiar with Git for change control and collaboration. • Solid fundamentals: TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, VLANs, subnetting, VPN/IPsec; deep troubleshooting skills across layers (L2–L7). • Operational excellence while prioritising security: monitoring, managing incidents and problems, and creating clear documentation. • Experience in enhancing endurance in regulated or high-availability environments, like financial services. descriptions.de: Mitglied des Netzwerkteams von Avaloq in Cloud & Infrastructure Operations. Sie werden mit der Sicherstellung einer sicheren, zuverlässigen Vernetzung und Netzwerkoperation beauftragt. Dazu gehören die Verwaltung von Verbindungen und Netzwerken zwischen und innerhalb unserer Rechenzentren, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), unsere Kunden und andere damit verbundene Dienstleistungen. Sie kombinieren die operative Disziplin mit Hand-on-Engineering und Automatisierung. Dadurch wird die aktuelle Einrichtung in einer geregelten Umgebung verbessert. Die operative Disziplin umfasst Stabilität, Handhabungsvorfälle und Aushärtung. Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben • Führen und betreiben Sie die Hybrid-Konnektivität, die das Unternehmen LAN/WAN, die Rechenzentren und OCI umfasst – mit hoher Verfügbarkeit, vorhersehbarer Leistung und robusten Sicherheitskontrollen. • Die Netzwerkplattform wird kontinuierlich verbessert und optimiert. Standardisierte Designs. Entfernen Sie die Komplexität. Verbessern Sie Ausdauer. Reduzieren Sie operatives Toil. Verwenden Sie Automatisierungstools wie Terraform und GitOps, um diese Ziele zu erreichen. • Netzwerkoperationen verwalten. Überwachen Sie das Netzwerk. Antwort auf Vorfälle. Problembehebung. Probleme verwalten. Führen Sie die Root-Cause-Analyse. Nehmen Sie vorbeugende Maßnahmen. • Zusammenarbeit mit den Architektur- und Vertriebsteams, um skalierbare, sichere Netzwerkdesigns für die Umsetzung und Verbesserung von Roadmaps zu erhalten. • Bewahren Sie die betrieblichen Dokumente hochwertig. Dazu gehören Runbooks, Standards und Diagramme. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Dienstleistungen bereit sind, indem Sie auf gute Änderungspraktiken, Testmethoden und klare Übergaben. Qualifikation • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Netzwerktechnik. Diese Erfahrung muss die Arbeit in komplexen Unternehmensumgebungen beinhalten. • Fähigkeiten im Routing und Switching, WAN und Internet-Konnektivität, Firewalls und Lastausgleich. • Es ist eine solide Einsicht in die Hybrid-Cloud-Vernetzung erforderlich. Dies beinhaltet Erfahrung mit Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). • Ein Infrastruktur-as-Code Mindset. Nützliche Erfahrung mit Terraform, ob durch die Erstellung oder Nutzung von Modulen, und mit Git für Änderungskontrolle und Zusammenarbeit vertraut sein. • Solide Grundlagen: TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, VLANs, Subnetting, VPN/IPsec; tiefe Fehlerbehebung Fähigkeiten über Schichten (L2–L7). • Operationelle Exzellenz bei der Priorisierung der Sicherheit: Überwachung, Verwaltung von Vorfällen und Problemen und Schaffung klarer Dokumentationen. • Erfahrung in der Verbesserung der Ausdauer in regulierten oder hochverfügbaren Umgebungen, wie Finanzdienstleistungen. Es wäre ein echter Bonus, wenn Sie • Sie haben Zertifizierungen wie CCNP, OCI Networking (Associate oder Professional), CheckPoint CCSE, FortiGate FCP und Terraform Associate. • Erfahrung mit SD-WAN Wie Sie arbeiten • Sie kommunizieren deutlich mit technischen und nichttechnischen Akteuren und arbeiten gut in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen. • Sie sind neugierig und pragmatisch: eifrig zu lernen, aber konzentriert auf die Bereitstellung sicherer, pflegefähiger Lösungen. • Sie bleiben unter Spannung strukturiert und können bei Vorfällen und Lieferspitzen entsprechend priorisieren. • Sprachen: fließend Englisch; Italienisch und/oder Deutsch sind ein Plus. • Schichtarbeit und/oder On-Call-Verpflichtung gelten je nach Servicebedarf. • Standort: Zürich, Schweiz • Aus regulatorischen Gründen ist eine Schweizer Residenz erforderlich Wenn Sie geschäftskritische Netzwerke betreiben und diese durch Automatisierung und Cloud Adoption (OCI) modernisieren, möchten wir von Ihnen hören. Wir mieten, kompensieren und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder anderen fantastischen Eigenschaften, die uns alle einzigartig machen, haben wir unser Bestes getan, um diese Anzeige in inklusive und neutral zu schreiben. descriptions.fr: Rejoignez l'équipe d'Avaloqs Network dans Cloud & Infrastructure Operations. Vous serez chargé d'assurer une connectivité et des opérations réseau sûres et fiables. descriptions.fr: L'équipe Securities Trading & Treasury est à la recherche d'un analyste technique IT pour l'analyse des besoins, la conception des solutions et les activités de paramétrage sur la plateforme centrale d'Avaloq. Ce rôle offre l'occasion de participer à un large éventail de projets passionnants et stimulants, contribuant ainsi à des initiatives bancaires mondiales de pointe. L'équipe travaille dans un environnement agile, collaborant étroitement avec les clients et les partenaires pour soutenir une vaste clientèle internationale en CH/FL et en APAC, et pour fournir des solutions innovantes qui répondent aux exigences changeantes du marché. Vos tâches clés • Analyser les exigences et les processus opérationnels dans le domaine du Trésor et des opérations sur titres • Évaluer d'autres scénarios et recommander des solutions commerciales et informatiques optimales • Concevoir, construire, paramétrer et maintenir des solutions sur la plateforme Avaloq • Participer activement aux projets de mise en œuvre et aux ateliers de la clientèle • Gérer les relations avec les clients par la communication régulière et la consultation professionnelle • Préparer des rapports et de la documentation sur les nouveaux besoins des clients, les activités en cours et l'état du projet; • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des solutions de négociation de titres et de trésorerie d'Avaloq, des normes de mise en œuvre et des initiatives novatrices de développement de produits Qualifiche • Diplôme universitaire en informatique/ingénierie/mathématique ou équivalent • Minimum de 3 ans d'expérience en analyse d'entreprise et en ingénierie des exigences dans le secteur financier • Bonnes compétences en programmation • Fortes compétences analytiques, de résolution de problèmes et conceptuelles • Excellente orientation client et excellente communication • Méthode de travail automotivée, proactive et structurée avec une passion pour l'apprentissage Ce serait un vrai bonus si vous aviez • Connaissance approfondie en PL/SQL • Expérience avec Avaloq ou d'autres systèmes bancaires • Expérience dans le domaine du Trésor et des valeurs mobilières • La compréhension des bases de données relationnelles (SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle PL/SQL). • Expérience des méthodologies agiles • Langues italienne, allemande et française Informations complémentaires Nous nous rendons compte que la gestion de l'équilibre de vie au travail est un défi auquel nous sommes tous confrontés dans notre vie quotidienne et pour soutenir avec cela nous sommes heureux d'offrir un travail hybride et flexible pour la plupart de nos Avaloqers pour maintenir l'équilibre de vie au travail et pour continuer notre fantastique culture Avaloq dans nos bureaux mondiaux. descriptions.it: Avaloq sta cercando un esperto consulente di soluzioni tecniche per aderire all'organizzazione Global Solutions Consulting. Il ruolo è responsabile per la progettazione di soluzioni end-to-end, il supporto commerciale e l'esecuzione RFP/RFI per complesse opportunità bancarie tra privati, gestione patrimoniale e clienti bancari universali. Il candidato di successo fungerà da consulente tecnico e di soluzione affidabile per i clienti e gli stakeholder interni, possiedendo l'integrità della soluzione in dimensioni funzionali, tecniche, commerciali e di consegna. Vendite & Customer Engagement • Agite come un'autorità di soluzioni che supporta le opportunità di vendita Avaloq principalmente in Europa e Nord America. La partecipazione in altre regioni può essere necessaria al momento della richiesta. • Condurre o contribuire a workshop client, presentazioni di soluzioni e sessioni di due diligence, sia remote che in loco. • Tradurre i requisiti aziendali, normativi e IT in architetture di soluzioni basate su Avaloq. • Agire come consulente di fiducia per le parti interessate dei clienti senior, tra cui CIO, COO, Head of Operations e Enterprise Architecture. RFP, RFI & Deal Support • Gestire e fornire risposte RFP / RFI / Questionario tecnico con alta qualità, consistenza e defensibilità normativa. • Posizionamento, differenziatori e presupposti della propria soluzione, garantendo chiarezza tra funzionalità standard, configurabili e personalizzate. • Preparare il materiale del gate dell'affare (obiettivo di soluzione, complessità, rischi, assunzioni, driver di costo) in allineamento con vendite e consegna. • Assicurarsi che tutte le proposte di soluzione siano conformi ai quadri commerciali, legali, di rischio e di governance di Avaloq. Soluzioni Architettura e Design • Progettazione di soluzioni end-to-end che coprono: • Avaloq Core Platform (ACP) • Canali digitali (Web / RM Workplace) • Modelli comunitari di API, integrazione e messaggistica • Dati, analisi, reportistica e strumenti normativi • Modelli di hosting: SaaS, BPaaS, servizi gestiti, on-premise / client-hosted • Definire requisiti non funzionali tra cui: Gestione degli Stakeholder interni • Agite come soluzione primaria Point-of-Contact per i team di negoziazione interni, coordinando gli input da Prodotto, Architettura, Sicurezza, Legale e Consegna. • Gestione degli allineamenti interni, delle recensioni e delle approvazioni, verificabilità e tracciabilità delle decisioni. • Seguire e far rispettare i processi interni, la governance e le discipline di consegna. Qualifiche Domain & Industry • Forte esperienza in private banking, gestione patrimoniale o servizi finanziari IT. • Una solida comprensione delle operazioni bancarie, degli ambienti normativi (ad esempio FINMA, BCE, MAS, FCA) e dei controlli IT. Esperienza tecnologica Il candidato deve dimostrare l'esperienza pratica con le tecnologie comunemente utilizzate nelle soluzioni Avaloq, tra cui: • Piattaforme di core banking (Avaloq o sistemi tier‐1 comparabili) • Integrazione basata su API, Architettura di messaggistica e di eventi • Canali bancari digitali e piattaforme orientate al cliente • Concetti di cloud e hosting (OCI, AWS, Azure, modelli ibridi) • Forte comprensione dei Kubernetes compresi: • • Architettura di sicurezza, IAM, protezione dei dati e controlli di conformità • Infrastrutture dimensionamento, performance e design ad alta disponibilità • Tecnologie aziendali moderne (Kubernetes, containerizzazione, osservabilità, CI/CD) Competenze professionali • Ottimi capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali, adatte a C‐suite, regolatori e decisori dei clienti. • Forte capacità di presentazione e storytelling, traducendo la complessità in narrazioni chiare e defensibili. • Prove capacità di gestire più impegni paralleli sotto pressione temporale. • Alto livello di autonomia, responsabilità e professionalità. • Capacità di operare con fiducia in ambienti ambigui e di alto livello. Formazione e esperienza • Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Sistemi Informativi o esperienza equivalente. • Tipicamente 7–10+ anni di esperienza nella consulenza di soluzioni, pre-vendita o ruoli di architettura. • L'esperienza precedente che lavora in ambienti internazionali, organizzati a matrice è fortemente preferita. • L'inglese fluido è obbligatorio; le lingue europee aggiuntive sono fortemente preferite, in particolare: • il tedesco (molto auspicabile per i clienti svizzeri e DACH) • il francese (Svizzera / Francia / Benelux) • l'italiano o lo spagnolo (copertura Europa meridionale) • Capacità di operare comodamente in ambienti client multilingue e multiculturali, tra cui l'adattamento dello stile di comunicazione per diverse regioni. • L'esperienza di lavoro con istituzioni finanziarie europee regolamentate è un forte vantaggio. Informazioni Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali. In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico. Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro. Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento. #LI-Hybrid #
descriptions.en: Avaloq is seeking an experienced Technical Solution Consultant to join the Global Solutions Consulting organisation. The role is responsible for end‑to‑end solution design, commercial support and RFP/RFI execution for complex banking opportunities across private banking, wealth management and universal banking clients. The successful candidate will act as a trusted technical and solution advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, owning solution integrity across functional, technical, commercial and delivery dimensions. Your key tasks Sales & Client Engagement • Act as a customer‑facing solution authority supporting Avaloq sales opportunities primarily within Europe and North America. Involvement in other regions may be necessary when requried. • Lead or contribute to client workshops, solution presentations and due‑diligence sessions, both remote and on‑site. • Translate client business, regulatory and IT requirements into viable Avaloq‑based solution architectures. • Act as a trusted advisor for senior client stakeholders, including CIO, COO, Head of Operations and Enterprise Architecture. RFP, RFI & Deal Support • Manage and deliver RFP / RFI / Technical Questionnaire responses with high quality, consistency and regulatory defensibility. • Own solution positioning, differentiators and assumptions, ensuring clarity between standard, configurable and custom capabilities. • Prepare deal gate material (solution scope, complexity, risks, assumptions, cost drivers) in alignment with Sales and Delivery. • Ensure all solution proposals comply with Avaloq commercial, legal, risk and governance frameworks. Solution Architecture & Design • Design end‑to‑end solutions covering: • Avaloq Core Platform (ACP) • Digital Channels (Web / RM Workplace) • Community API, integration and messaging patterns • Data, analytics, reporting and regulatory tooling • Hosting models: SaaS, BPaaS, managed services, on‑premises / client‑hosted • Define non‑functional requirements including: • Security, IAM, data protection and regulatory compliance • High availability, DR, performance and scalability • Operational model, support and change processes • Partner closely with Delivery, Product Management, Hosting and Security teams to ensure solution feasibility and integrity. Internal Stakeholder Management • Act as primary solution Point-of-Contact for internal deal‑making teams, coordinating input from Product, Architecture, Security, Legal and Delivery. • Manage internal alignments, reviews and approvals, ensuring auditability and traceability of decisions. • Follow and enforce internal processes, governance and handover disciplines to Delivery. ## Qualifiche Domain & Industry • Strong experience in private banking, wealth management or financial services IT. • Solid understanding of banking operations, regulatory environments (e.g. FINMA, ECB, MAS, FCA) and IT controls. Technology Expertise The candidate must demonstrate hands‑on experience with technologies commonly used within Avaloq solutions, including: • Core banking platforms (Avaloq or comparable tier‑1 systems) • API‑based integration, messaging and event‑driven architectures • Digital banking channels and client‑facing platforms • Cloud and hosting concepts (OCI, AWS, Azure, hybrid models) • Strong understanding of Kubernetes including: • Container orchestration concepts, networking and security • High availability, resilience and scaling patterns • Operational concerns: monitoring, logging, upgrades and lifecycle management • Experience positioning and designing solutions running on: • Managed Kubernetes services (e.g. OpenShift, EKS, AKS or equivalent) • Hybrid or on‑premises Kubernetes environments • Ability to articulate Kubernetes value propositions, risks and operational implications clearly to clients and non‑technical stakeholders. • Security architecture, IAM, data protection and compliance controls • Infrastructure sizing, performance and high‑availability design • Modern enterprise technologies (Kubernetes, containerisation, observability, CI/CD) Professional Skills • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, suitable for C‑suite, regulators and client decision‑makers. • Strong presentation and storytelling ability, translating complexity into clear, defensible narratives. • Proven ability to manage multiple parallel engagements under time pressure. • High level of autonomy, accountability and professionalism. • Ability to operate confidently in ambiguous, high‑stakes deal environments. Education & Experience • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent experience. • Typically 7–10+ years experience in solution consulting, pre‑sales or architecture roles. • Prior experience working in international, matrix‑organised environments is strongly preferred. Language & Cultural Capability • Fluent English is mandatory; additional European languages are strongly preferred, particularly: • German (highly desirable for Swiss and DACH clients) • French (Switzerland / France / Benelux) • Italian or Spanish (southern Europe coverage) • Ability to operate comfortably in multilingual, multicultural client environments, including adapting communication style for different regions. • Experience working with regulated European financial institutions is a strong advantage. ## Informazioni aggiuntive We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. descriptions.fr: Avaloq cherche un consultant en solutions techniques expérimenté pour rejoindre l'organisation Global Solutions Consulting. Ce rôle est responsable de la conception de solutions de bout en bout, du soutien commercial et de l'exécution de la DP/RFI pour les possibilités bancaires complexes dans les secteurs de la banque privée, de la gestion de patrimoine et de la clientèle bancaire universelle. Le candidat retenu agira à titre de conseiller technique et de solution de confiance auprès des clients et des intervenants internes, possédant l'intégrité de la solution dans toutes les dimensions fonctionnelles, techniques, commerciales et de prestation. Vos tâches clés Ventes et engagement des clients • Agir en tant qu'autorité de solution orientée vers le client pour soutenir les débouchés de Avaloq principalement en Europe et en Amérique du Nord. La participation dans d'autres régions peut être nécessaire lorsqu'elle est demandée. • Diriger ou contribuer aux ateliers de clients, aux présentations de solutions et aux séances de diligence raisonnable, à distance et sur place. • Traduire les exigences en matière d'affaires client, de réglementation et de TI en architectures de solutions viables basées sur Avaloq. • Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des principaux clients, y compris les DPI, les DCO, le chef des opérations et l'architecture d'entreprise. RFP, DDR et support de transaction • Gérer et livrer les réponses aux demandes de propositions, aux demandes de renseignements et aux questionnaires techniques avec une grande qualité, cohérence et défendabilité réglementaire. • Positionnement de la solution, différenciations et hypothèses, assurant une clarté entre les capacités standard, configurables et personnalisées. • Préparer le matériel de porte d'entente (étendue de la solution, complexité, risques, hypothèses, facteurs de coûts) en accord avec les ventes et la livraison. • Veiller à ce que toutes les propositions de solutions soient conformes aux cadres commerciaux, juridiques, de risque et de gouvernance d'Avaloq. Architecture et conception des solutions • Concevoir des solutions de bout en bout couvrant: • Plateforme centrale d'Avaloq • Chaînes numériques (Web / RM Workplace) • API communautaire, intégration et modèles de messagerie • Outils de données, d'analyse, de rapport et de réglementation • Modèles d'hébergement : SaaS, BPaaS, services gérés, sur site / hébergés par le client • Définir des exigences non fonctionnelles, notamment: • Sécurité, IAM, protection des données et conformité réglementaire • Haute disponibilité, DR, performances et évolutivité • Modèle opérationnel, soutien et processus de changement • Collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de livraison, de gestion des produits, d'hébergement et de sécurité pour assurer la faisabilité et l'intégrité des solutions. Gestion interne des intervenants • Agir comme solution principale Point de contact pour les équipes de négociation internes, en coordonnant les commentaires des produits, de l'architecture, de la sécurité, du droit et de la livraison. • Gérer les alignements internes, les examens et les approbations, en assurant la vérification et la traçabilité des décisions. • Suivre et faire respecter les processus internes, la gouvernance et les disciplines de transfert à la prestation. Qualifiche Domaine & Industrie • Forte expérience en banque privée, gestion de patrimoine ou services financiers IT. • Une bonne compréhension des opérations bancaires, des environnements réglementaires (par exemple FINMA, BCE, MAS, FCA) et des contrôles informatiques. Expertise technologique Le candidat doit démontrer son expérience pratique des technologies couramment utilisées dans les solutions Avaloq, notamment : • Plates-formes bancaires de base (systèmes Avaloq ou de niveau 1 comparables) • Intégration, messagerie et architectures basées sur l'API • Les canaux bancaires numériques et les plateformes orientées vers le client • Concepts de cloud et d'hébergement (OCI, AWS, Azure, modèles hybrides) • Une bonne compréhension des Kubernetes, notamment: • Concepts d'orchestration de conteneurs, mise en réseau et sécurité • Des modèles de disponibilité, de résilience et d'échelle élevés • Préoccupations opérationnelles: surveillance, exploitation forestière, modernisation et gestion du cycle de vie • Expérimentez le positionnement et la conception de solutions fonctionnant sur: • Services Kubernetes gérés (par exemple OpenShift, EKS, AKS ou équivalent) • Environnements Kubernetes hybrides ou sur site • Capacité d'articuler clairement les propositions de valeur, les risques et les implications opérationnelles de Kubernetes pour les clients et les intervenants non techniques. • Architecture de sécurité, IAM, protection des données et contrôles de conformité • Taille de l'infrastructure, performances et conception à haute disponibilité • Technologies d'entreprise modernes (Kubernetes, conteneurisation, observabilité, CI/CD) Compétences professionnelles • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, adaptées aux C‐suite, aux régulateurs et aux décideurs clients. • Forte capacité de présentation et de narration, transformant la complexité en récits clairs et défendables. • Capacité éprouvée de gérer plusieurs engagements parallèles sous pression temporelle. • Niveau élevé d'autonomie, de responsabilité et de professionnalisme. • Capacité d'opérer avec confiance dans des environnements ambigus et à fort rendement. Éducation et expérience • Diplôme en informatique, génie, systèmes d'information ou expérience équivalente. • Typiquement 7-10+ ans d'expérience en conseil en solutions, pré-ventes ou rôles d'architecture. • L'expérience antérieure dans des environnements organisés en matrice internationale est fortement préférée. Capacités linguistiques et culturelles • L'anglais est obligatoire; d'autres langues européennes sont fortement préférées, notamment: • Allemand (très souhaitable pour les clients suisses et DACH) • Français (Suisse / France / Benelux) • Italien ou espagnol (couverture Europe du Sud) • Capacité à fonctionner confortablement dans des environnements multilingues et multiculturels, y compris en adaptant le style de communication à différentes régions. • L'expérience de travail avec les institutions financières européennes réglementées constitue un avantage important. descriptions.it: Si tratta di un’opportunità entusiasmante per un consulente di soluzioni focalizzato sul cliente per unire il nostro ufficio svizzero e svolgere un ruolo chiave nel guidare la crescita di Avaloq sui mercati europei e svizzeri. Lavorando all'intersezione delle vendite, del prodotto e della consegna, vi impegnate con i principali istituti finanziari per comprendere le loro sfide strategiche, modellare soluzioni su misura e posizionare Avaloq come partner affidabile a lungo termine. I vostri compiti chiave: • Guidare le attività di consulenza della soluzione attraverso il ciclo di vendita completo, dalla scoperta precoce attraverso la progettazione della soluzione e il passaggio alla consegna. • Deformazione della soluzione di piombo e consolidamento dei requisiti, traducendo le complesse esigenze aziendali in proposte di soluzione convincenti e fattibili. • Progettare e fornire impegni di cliente impeccabili (presentazioni, demo, workshop), articolando chiaramente la proposta di valore di Avaloq agli stakeholder senior e ai decisori. • Coordinare e coordinare i processi RFI / RFP, garantendo risposte di alta qualità, coerenti e competitive allineate alle aspettative dei clienti. • Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team interfunzionali (Sales, Product, Architecture, Pricing, Delivery) per garantire l'allineamento tra le esigenze del cliente e le funzionalità Avaloq. • Assicurare una chiara documentazione e comunicazione del campo di applicazione della soluzione, supportando la trasparenza dal pre-vendita attraverso l'implementazione. Qualifiche • La fluidità in tedesco (C1/C2) è obbligatoria. • Provato track record in Solution Consulting, Pre‐Sales o Sales Engineering, idealmente all'interno di banking, gestione della ricchezza, o fintech. • Forte capacità di coinvolgere e influenzare gli stakeholder senior, tra cui livello C (incl. livello C). • Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti complessi e multi-stakeholder in tutte le regioni • Volontà di viaggiare in tutta Europa. Sarebbe un vero bonus se avete: • Esperienza nel settore dei servizi finanziari, FinTech o Consulting • Uno sfondo tecnico in Ingegneria Software o disciplina correlata Informazioni Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali. In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico. descriptions.en: Product Strategy & Offering’s mission is to lead the early phases of the product value chain. We oversee budgets, drive investment decisions, and prioritize the entire product portfolio in the best interest of Avaloq and its broad client community. The team engages with numerous stakeholders and plays a central role in advocating for and conveying clear messages around our products throughout the organization and to external parties, with marketing providing support. We value curiosity, adaptability, collaboration, and dedication. Your key tasks • Own the R&D portfolio roadmap, and the related budget. Ensure data completeness including product timelines, sales pipeline, strategy alignment • Product/features decisions: prioritize based on revenue impact, client community interest and company strategy; balance short-term revenue with long-term product health • Define and track revenue KPIs. Take action to address revenue shortcomings and promote growth areas for the R&D portfolio • Prepare documentation for the communication to Senior Management, Group Executive Board and externally to clients ## Qualifiche • Bachelor’s degree in business and economics or information technology or engineering • Minimum 10 years’ experience in software financial industry and knowledge of banking products • Skilled in negotiation and influence, able to push back on requests that are not scalable, align teams around value and pricing, and facilitate decisions across functions without direct authority • Highly organized, self-directed, and detail-oriented; adept at engaging with multiple stakeholders and managing a broad product portfolio • Demonstrates strong financial expertise and is proficient in business case development, investments and budgeting processes • Capable of making complex, high-impact trade-offs to optimize portfolio value and establish effective priorities • Client-focused with outstanding communication abilities • Proficiency in English. descriptions.de: Die Mission von Product Strategy & Angebot ist es, die frühen Phasen der Produktwertkette zu führen. Als Team bieten wir Marktforschungs-Einsichten, um den Wert und die Preise unseres Produktangebots zu artikulieren. Wir überwachen Budgets, steuern Investitionsentscheidungen und priorisieren das gesamte Produktportfolio im besten Interesse von Avaloq und seiner breiten Kundengemeinschaft. Wir übersetzen die Unternehmensstrategie in Produktentwicklung und Innovation, indem wir mit dem Ökosystem unserer Partner inszenieren und integrieren. Das Team beschäftigt sich mit zahlreichen Stakeholdern und spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Befürwortung und Förderung klarer Botschaften rund um unsere Produkte in der gesamten Organisation und an externe Parteien, mit Marketing-Support. descriptions.en: Product Strategy & Offering’s mission is to lead the early phases of the product value chain. As a team, we provide market research insights to articulate the value and pricing of our product offering. We oversee budgets, drive investment decisions, and prioritize the entire product portfolio in the best interest of Avaloq and its broad client community. We translate company strategy into product evolution and innovation by orchestrating and integrating with our partners’ ecosystem. The team engages with numerous stakeholders and plays a central role in advocating for and conveying clear messages around our products throughout the organization and to external parties, with marketing providing support. We value curiosity, adaptability, collaboration, and dedication. Your key tasks • Analyze market trends in managed regions for target client segments • Assess the client base, evaluate needs and buying behavior • Study competitors’ pricing and positioning; identify gaps in the market and unique selling proposition to shape a differentiation strategy • Align with sales and customers to review requirements and share insight within the product organization to maximize value ## Qualifiche • Bachelor’s degree in business and economics or information technology or engineering • Minimum 10 years’ experience in software financial industry and knowledge of banking products • Skilled in market research and presenting to analysts, focusing on key financial industry players • Strong analytical and data skills; adept at turning data into actionable decisions and understanding metrics • Strategic mindset: identify markets and segments, define winning strategies, plan for the long term • Extensive network and effective networking abilities • Proficiency in English. German and Italian are an advantage It would be a real bonus if you have • Master’s degree in business and economics or information technology or engineering • Experience in a B2B SaaS organization • Avaloq products knowledge ## Informazioni aggiuntive We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. Wir schätzen Neugier, Anpassungsfähigkeit, Zusammenarbeit und Hingabe. Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben • Monetisierung und Preisstrategie: Produktwert bewerten und gestalten, die Marktchancen mit dem Verkauf bestätigen und optimale Preise für neue Starts festlegen • Verwalten und pflegen Sie den Produktkatalog, halten es aktuell, konsistent und zugänglich • Go-to-Market-Planung durch Konsolidierung von Geschäftsfällen und Unterstützung von Vertriebsteams für erfolgreiche Produkteinführungen • Verwenden Sie zwingendes Storytelling, um Avaloq-Lösungen und Drittanbieter-Angebote im Ökosystem zu fördern • Support-Verkäufe bei der Bereitstellung von Vorbereitung zur Endkundenzufriedenheit Qualifikation • Bachelor-Abschluss in Wirtschaft und Informatik oder Ingenieurwesen • Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Software-Finanzindustrie und Wissen über Bankprodukte • Stakeholder Management: Zusammenarbeit effektiv mit Vertrieb, Marketing, Finanzen, Produktmanagement, Unternehmensanalysten und dem Führungsteam • Geschäfts- und Finanzausstattung: Nachweise für das Verständnis von P&L-Anweisungen und Gewinnspannen, Kenntnisse über SaaS-Metriken und fachgerechte Entwicklung und Bewertung von Geschäftsfällen • Kunden- und Markteindruck: erkennen, was den Kundenwert und die Zahlungsbereitschaft antreibt, starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zeigt • Experimentelle Denkweise: Anzeige der Anpassungsfähigkeit in mehrdeutigen Situationen und umfassen iterative Prozesse • Englischkenntnisse. Deutsch und Italienisch sind ein Vorteil Es wäre ein echter Bonus, wenn Sie • Masterstudiengang Wirtschafts- und Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Informatik oder Ingenieurwesen • Erfahrung in einer B2B SaaS-Organisation • Avaloq Produkte Wissen Informazioni aggiunt Wir erkennen, dass das Management von Arbeitslebensbilanz eine Herausforderung ist, die wir alle in unserem täglichen Leben stellen und um damit zu unterstützen, freuen wir uns, für die meisten unserer Avaloqers eine hybride und flexible Arbeit anbieten zu können, um das Arbeitslebensgleichgewicht zu erhalten und unsere fantastische Avaloq-Kultur in unseren globalen Büros fortzusetzen. In Avaloq sind wir stolz darauf, Vielfalt zu akzeptieren und zu verstehen, dass der Erfolg unseres Unternehmens auf der Macht verschiedener Meinungen aufgebaut ist, sind wir ganz herzlich dazu verpflichtet, eine Chancengleichheitsumgebung und inklusive Kultur zu fördern, in der Sie Ihr wahres authentisches Selbst sein können. Wir mieten, kompensieren und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder anderen fantastischen Eigenschaften, die uns alle einzigartig machen, haben wir unser Bestes getan, um diese Anzeige in inklusive und neutral zu schreiben. Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir keine spekulativen Bewerbungsunterlagen für eine unserer Aufgaben von Rekrutierungsagenturen akzeptieren werden, und alle nicht ausdrücklichen Bewerbungsunterlagen werden von den Zahlungserwartungen befreit. #LI-Hybrid
descriptions.fr: Stratégie et offre de produits La mission consiste à diriger les premières phases de la chaîne de valeur des produits. En tant qu'équipe, nous fournissons des renseignements sur les études de marché afin d'expliquer la valeur et le prix de notre offre de produits. Nous supervisons les budgets, dirigeons les décisions d'investissement et priorisons l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits dans le meilleur intérêt d'Avaloq et de sa vaste communauté de clients. Nous traduisons la stratégie de l'entreprise en évolution de produit et innovation en orchestrant et en intégrant avec nos partenaires l'écosystème. L'équipe collabore avec de nombreux intervenants et joue un rôle central dans la défense et la transmission de messages clairs autour de nos produits dans l'ensemble de l'organisation et auprès de parties externes, avec le soutien du marketing. Nous apprécions la curiosité, l'adaptabilité, la collaboration et le dévouement. Vos tâches clés • Stratégie de monétisation et de tarification: évaluer et façonner la valeur du produit, confirmer avec les ventes les opportunités du marché, et déterminer le prix optimal pour les nouveaux lancements • Gérer et maintenir le catalogue de produits, le tenir à jour, cohérent et accessible • Conduire la planification de l'accès au marché en consolidant les analyses de rentabilisation et en soutenant les équipes de vente pour des introductions réussies de produits • Utilisez des narrations convaincantes pour promouvoir les solutions Avaloq et les offres de tiers dans l'écosystème • Soutenir les ventes en offrant la préparation assurant la satisfaction du client final Qualifiche • Baccalauréat en affaires et en économie ou en technologie de l'information ou en ingénierie • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le secteur financier logiciel et la connaissance des produits bancaires • Gestion des parties prenantes : collaborer efficacement avec les ventes, le marketing, les finances, la gestion des produits, les analystes commerciaux et l'équipe de direction • Le sens des affaires et des finances : faire preuve de compétence dans la compréhension des états financiers et des marges bénéficiaires, connaître les paramètres de SaaS et développer et évaluer avec compétence des analyses de rentabilisation • L'empathie du client et du marché : reconnaître ce qui motive la valeur du client et sa volonté de payer, présenter de solides capacités de communication • L'état d'esprit de l'expérimentation: montrer l'adaptabilité dans des situations ambiguës et embrasser des processus itératifs • Compétence en anglais. L'allemand et l'italien sont un avantage Ce serait un vrai bonus si vous aviez • Maîtrise en commerce et économie ou en informatique ou en ingénierie • Expérience dans une organisation B2B SaaS • Connaissance des produits Avaloq Informations complémentaires Nous nous rendons compte que la gestion de l'équilibre de vie au travail est un défi auquel nous sommes tous confrontés dans notre vie quotidienne et pour soutenir avec cela nous sommes heureux d'offrir un travail hybride et flexible pour la plupart de nos Avaloqers pour maintenir l'équilibre de vie au travail et pour continuer notre fantastique culture Avaloq dans nos bureaux mondiaux. À Avaloq, nous sommes fiers d'embrasser la diversité et de comprendre que le succès de notre entreprise est fondé sur la puissance des différentes opinions, nous sommes tout à fait engagés à favoriser un environnement d'égalité des chances et une culture inclusive où vous pouvez être votre véritable soi authentique. Nous recrutons, compensons et promouvons indépendamment de l'origine, de l'âge, de l'identité de genre, de l'orientation sexuelle ou de tout autre caractère fantastique qui nous rend uniques, nous avons fait de notre mieux pour écrire cette annonce de manière inclusive et neutre. Veuillez noter que nous n'accepterons aucune soumission de CV spéculative pour l'un de nos rôles des agences de recrutement, et toute soumission non sollicitée sera exemptée de toute attente de paiement. #LI-Hybrid

descriptions.it:
We are seeking a highly skilled, fast learner and well rounded, AI Software Engineer to join our AI innovation lab team. The ideal candidate will lead AI experiments and bring cutting-edge AI Agentic solutions from ideation to production.
The mission of Avaloq AI Lab is to improve operational efficiency and augment Back-to-Front Office user experiences, through the application of state-of-the-art AI technology. We work collaboratively with industry leaders to deliver responsible and impactful solutions. Our team develops products tailored to the banking sector, supporting a broad range of users including banking operations, software engineers, knowledge services teams, and relationship managers.
Your key tasks

• Lead AI experiments and develop solutions from ideation to production

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement Agentic AI solutions

• Develop advanced prompts, multi-Agents architecture and tools

• Deploy and maintain LLM based solutions in production

• Optimize solutions for performance, cost, and scalability

• Stay up-to-date and evaluate the latest advancements in AI research and related regulations

## Qualifiche

• At least B.Sc. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

• Strong background in data science, statistics, and experimental thinking

• Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles

• Effective communication and collaboration skills

• Excellent analytical, coding, and debugging skills in Python

• At least 5 years of experience in Full-Stack Software Development

• At least 3 years of applied ML experience, with 2 years of experience with LLMs and Agents

• Proven track-record of deploying and maintaining AI models in production

• ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn or similar

• RAG pipelines with vector stores (e.g., Chroma, Qdrant)

• Agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Google ADK, CrewAI)

• Cloud AI services e.g. AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), Azure (AI Studio), GCP (Vertex AI)

• LLM & Agent Ops - experiment tracking tools, observability tools, evaluation pipelines, prompt engineering and maintenance tools

• Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g. Docker) and container orchestration systems (e.g. Kubernetes)

• Micro-services and REST APIs

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.
