• Durchführung von Forschung und Benchmarking zu Best Practices in den Bereichen Menschen, Kommunikationsstrategie und organisatorische Transformation

• Unterstützung der Vorbereitung von Materialien für Vorstandsausschüsse und Vorstandsdiskussionen
Veränderung & Transformation

• Fahren Sie die Planung und folgt der Umsetzung von großen Menschen und Kulturinitiativen

• Koordination von Change Management und Kommunikationsstrategien, um eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicherzustellen

• Auswirkungen und Fortschritt von Transformationsprogrammen überwachen
Governance & Stakeholder Koordination

• Etablierung von Governance-Frameworks für große Initiativen

• Organisation und Unterstützung von Führungsforen, Lenkungsausschüssen und Projektvorständen

• Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf HR, Kommunikation und andere Geschäftsfunktionen

• Verfolgen Sie Entscheidungen, Handlungen und Rechenschaftspflicht in strategischen Programmen

## Qualifiziert

• 15+ Jahre Erfahrung in Strategie, Beratung, Programmmanagement, HR oder Business Operations

• Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer funktionsübergreifender Projekte oder Transformationsinitiativen

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Strategie in die Tat umzusetzen

• Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit Erfahrung in der Vorbereitung von Präsentationen und Berichten auf Führungsebene

• Hoch organisiert mit starken Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Mehrdeutigkeiten zu navigieren und Fortschritte in einer dynamischen Umgebung zu erzielen
Es wäre ein echter Bonus, wenn Sie

• Erfahrung in Managementberatung, Unternehmensstrategie oder People Strategy/HR Transformation

• Vertrautheit mit People Analytics, Organisationsdesign, digitalen HR-Tools oder Kulturinitiativen

• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit leitenden Angestellten oder Führungsteams

## Informazioni aggiuntive

Wir wissen, dass das Management der Work-Life-Balance eine Herausforderung ist, der wir alle in unserem täglichen Leben gegenüberstehen, und um dies zu unterstützen, freuen wir uns, den meisten unserer Avaloqer ein hybrides und flexibles Arbeiten anzubieten, um die Work-Life-Balance zu erhalten und unsere fantastische Avaloq-Kultur in unseren globalen Büros fortzusetzen.
Bei Avaloq sind wir stolz darauf, Vielfalt anzunehmen und zu verstehen, dass der Erfolg unseres Unternehmens auf der Kraft unterschiedlicher Meinungen basiert, wir sind von ganzem Herzen bestrebt, eine Chancengleichheit und eine integrative Kultur zu fördern, in der Sie Ihr wahres authentisches Selbst sein können.
Wir stellen, kompensieren und fördern unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung oder anderen fantastischen Eigenschaften, die uns alle einzigartig machen, wir haben unser Bestes getan, um diese Anzeige in einer integrativen und neutralen Weise zu schreiben.
Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir keine spekulativen CV-Einreichungen für unsere Rollen von Rekrutierungsagenturen annehmen werden und dass unerwünschte Kandidateneinreichungen von Zahlungserwartungen ausgenommen sind.
descriptions.fr:
C'est une occasion fantastique pour un projet stratégique et axé sur l'exécution et la gestion d'entreprise Dirigez-vous vers nous et soutenez le responsable du secteur d'activité « Personnes et communications » et la fonction « Personnes et communications ». Ce rôle se situe à l'intersection de la stratégie, des opérations et de la transformation, en veillant à ce que les initiatives clés dans les domaines des personnes, de la culture et des communications soient conçues, exécutées et mises en oeuvre efficacement.
Vous agirez à titre de partenaire stratégique et de chef de programme, en traduisant les priorités en programmes structurés, en menant des initiatives interfonctionnelles et en assurant une gouvernance, des rapports et un suivi solides. L'un des principaux objectifs de ce rôle sera d'appuyer le développement d'une fonction moderne, axée sur les données et axée sur l'entreprise, People & Communications, aidant à façonner le fonctionnement de la fonction, offrant de la valeur et des partenaires avec l'entreprise.
Ce rôle est idéal pour quelqu'un qui combine la pensée stratégique et l'exécution pratique de projets et qui aime travailler dans un environnement rapide et très collaboratif.
Gestion du programme

• Diriger et gérer les initiatives stratégiques à l'échelle des personnes, de la culture, des communications et de la gestion des lieux

• Traduire la stratégie fonctionnelle en programmes structurés, feuilles de route et plans d'exécution

• Coordonner les projets interfonctionnels impliquant les RH, les communications, le leadership et d'autres équipes d'affaires

• Suivre les étapes, les risques, les budgets et les produits livrables pour assurer une exécution réussie
Bâtir une fonction moderne pour les personnes et les communications

• Soutenir la conception et la mise en oeuvre d'une fonction moderne, orientée vers l'avenir, People & Communications, en collaboration avec les divisions

• Aider à définir les modèles opérationnels, la gouvernance et les façons de travailler qui permettent des partenariats d'affaires solides et une prestation efficace

• Contribuer et/ou diriger des initiatives liées à l'expérience des employés, à la vision des données et aux RH numériques, à l'amélioration des processus et aux communications

• Déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer les processus, d'accroître l'impact et de tirer parti des données et de la technologie dans la prise de décisions

• Contribuer au renforcement de la fonction en tant que partenaire stratégique de l'entreprise et défenseur du peuple
Gestion d'entreprise et excellence opérationnelle

• Soutenir le cycle annuel de planification du BA, y compris les priorités stratégiques, les OKR et la budgétisation

• Surveiller le rendement et les progrès des initiatives clés au moyen de tableaux de bord et de rapports.

• Assurer l'harmonisation opérationnelle et la hiérarchisation des priorités dans l'ensemble de l'organisation des personnes et des communications

• Améliorer les processus, la gouvernance et les méthodes de travail au sein de la fonction
Appui exécutif

• Préparer des documents d'information, des analyses et des présentations de haute qualité à l'intention des dirigeants

• Connexions au sein des fonctions People & Communications ainsi qu'avec nos gens à travers Avaloq pour fournir des informations sur les tendances, l'engagement des gens, la culture et l'efficacité de la communication

• Mener des recherches et des analyses comparatives sur les meilleures pratiques en matière de stratégie en matière de ressources humaines et de communications et de transformation organisationnelle

• Appuyer la préparation de documents pour les comités exécutifs et les débats du conseil
Changement et transformation

• Diriger la planification et suivre la mise en œuvre des principales initiatives en matière de personnes et de culture

• Coordonner les stratégies de gestion du changement et de communication pour assurer une adoption réussie

• Surveiller l'impact et les progrès des programmes de transformation
Gouvernance et coordination des parties prenantes

• Établir des cadres de gouvernance pour les grandes initiatives

• Organiser et appuyer des forums de leadership, des comités directeurs et des conseils de projet

• Assurer l'harmonisation entre les RH, les communications et les autres fonctions opérationnelles

• Suivre les décisions, les mesures et la reddition de comptes dans l'ensemble des programmes stratégiques

## Qualifiche

• 15 ans et plus d'expérience en stratégie, conseil, gestion de programme, RH ou opérations opérationnelles

• Expérience de projets transfonctionnels complexes ou d'initiatives de transformation

• Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de traduire la stratégie en action

• Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication avec l'expérience en préparation de présentations et de rapports au niveau des cadres supérieurs

• Hautement organisé avec de solides capacités de gestion de projet, avec la capacité de naviguer l'ambiguïté et de conduire les progrès dans un environnement dynamique
Ce serait un vrai bonus si vous aviez

• Expérience en conseil en gestion, en stratégie d'entreprise ou en transformation des ressources humaines

• Connaissance de l'analyse des personnes, de la conception organisationnelle, des outils numériques de RH ou des initiatives culturelles

• Expérience de travail avec des cadres supérieurs ou des équipes de direction

## Informations complémentaires

Nous nous rendons compte que la gestion de l'équilibre de vie au travail est un défi auquel nous sommes tous confrontés dans notre vie quotidienne et pour soutenir avec cela nous sommes heureux d'offrir un travail hybride et flexible pour la plupart de nos Avaloqers pour maintenir l'équilibre de vie au travail et pour continuer notre fantastique culture Avaloq dans nos bureaux mondiaux.
À Avaloq, nous sommes fiers d'embrasser la diversité et de comprendre que le succès de notre entreprise est fondé sur la puissance des différentes opinions, nous sommes tout à fait engagés à favoriser un environnement d'égalité des chances et une culture inclusive où vous pouvez être votre véritable soi authentique.
Nous recrutons, compensons et promouvons indépendamment de l'origine, de l'âge, de l'identité de genre, de l'orientation sexuelle ou de tout autre caractère fantastique qui nous rend uniques, nous avons fait de notre mieux pour écrire cette annonce de manière inclusive et neutre.
Veuillez noter que nous n'accepterons aucune soumission de CV spéculative pour l'un de nos rôles des agences de recrutement, et toute soumission non sollicitée sera exemptée de toute attente de paiement.

descriptions.it:
We are seeking a highly skilled, fast learner and well rounded, AI Software Engineer to join our AI innovation lab team. The ideal candidate will lead AI experiments and bring cutting-edge AI Agentic solutions from ideation to production.  
The mission of Avaloq AI Lab is to improve operational efficiency and augment Back-to-Front Office user experiences, through the application of state-of-the-art AI technology. We work collaboratively with industry leaders to deliver responsible and impactful solutions. Our team develops products tailored to the banking sector, supporting a broad range of users including banking operations, software engineers, knowledge services teams, and relationship managers. 
Your key tasks  

• Lead AI experiments and develop solutions from ideation to production 

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement Agentic AI solutions  

• Develop advanced prompts, multi-Agents architecture and tools 

• Deploy and maintain LLM based solutions in production 

• Optimize solutions for performance, cost, and scalability 

• Stay up-to-date and evaluate the latest advancements in AI research and related regulations

## Qualifiche

• At least B.Sc. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field  

• Strong background in data science, statistics, and experimental thinking   

• Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles  

• Effective communication and collaboration skills  

• Excellent analytical, coding, and debugging skills in Python

• At least 5 years of experience in Full-Stack Software Development  

• At least 3 years of applied ML experience, with 2 years of experience with LLMs and Agents   

• Proven track-record of deploying and maintaining AI models in production  

• ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn or similar 

• RAG pipelines with vector stores (e.g., Chroma, Qdrant) 

• Agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Google ADK, CrewAI) 

• Cloud AI services e.g. AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), Azure (AI Studio), GCP (Vertex AI)    

• LLM & Agent Ops - experiment tracking tools, observability tools, evaluation pipelines, prompt engineering and maintenance tools 

• Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g. Docker) and container orchestration systems (e.g. Kubernetes) 

• Micro-services and REST APIs

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. 
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. 
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. 
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

descriptions.it:
Come Senior Business Analista sarai un membro chiave della divisione operazioni bancarie di Avaloq, che funge da guida funzionale all'interno del team Asset Data Sourcing. Banking Operations funge da back office per oltre 30 banche a livello globale, garantendo un'elaborazione efficiente, conforme e affidabile attraverso la piattaforma bancaria Avaloq.
Il team Asset Data Sourcing è responsabile per l'integrazione, la mappatura, la governance e la distribuzione dei dati master degli strumenti finanziari. In questo ruolo, prenderete la proprietà delle attività di approvvigionamento dei dati per il Global Financial Instruments Master Data Service (Asset Hub) di Avaloq e sostenere la leadership operativa e strategica del team.
I compiti chiave

• Responsabilità complessiva e organizzazione delle operazioni di servizio Asset Data Sourcing, come Senior Business Analyst

• Sostenere la leadership del team attraverso la pianificazione, la priorità e agire come punto di escalation senior per i dati complessi, client o problemi legati al fornitore

• Pianificazione e implementazione di asset, emittente, prezzi ecc. progetti di migrazione dei dati

• Progettazione e mantenimento di regole aziendali complesse, mappature e specifiche per le versioni di successo

• Impegnarsi con i nostri clienti nella cattura dei loro requisiti e implementazione (analisi di business, specifiche funzionali, test e rilascio)

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interne tra i team di Banking Operations, IT, Product e Regional per fornire soluzioni specifiche ai clienti all'interno dei nostri Servizi Master Data

• Nell'ambito della gestione del vendor & change, ti coordinaterai con i fornitori di dati (con SIX Financial ma anche Bloomberg) e consiglierai ai nostri consumatori di dati interni su argomenti di feed (VDFS/FLEX) e contenuti

• Conoscenza approfondita del fornitore di dati SIX Financial Information nel contesto dei feed di dati (VDFS) alla luce di essere un Facilitatore di servizio verso SIX FI

## Qualifiche

• Una comprovata qualificazione IT o aziendale combinata con un forte background di servizi bancari o finanziari

• Esperienza minima di 3 anni come Business Analyst nella gestione dei dati di riferimento e di mercato (ad esempio Asset Hub di una Banca)

• Forte esperienza pratica negli strumenti finanziari, master data, data delivery, modellazione dati e mappatura del sistema target

• Conoscenza approfondita della gestione dei dati finanziari SIX Financial Information data feed (VDF/VDFS) del contenuto dei dati finanziari e della consegna dei dati

• Una solida esperienza del sistema Enterprise Data Management "Temenos DataSource" (TDS) è obbligatoria

• L'esperienza nel motore di regola TDS, la configurazione, la personalizzazione e la modellazione dei dati è altamente auspicabile

• Conoscenza pratica in SQL. È richiesto lo scripting PL/SQL

• L'esperienza con il sistema bancario di base Avaloq è altamente vantaggioso

• Siete altamente motivati, proattivi e confortevoli assumendo la proprietà di argomenti critici, fornendo supervisione e direzione

• Capacità di collaborare efficacemente con i team interfunzionali e internazionali

• Forte mentalità analitica con un approccio orientato al cliente e orientato alla soluzione

• Confidente comunicatore, in grado di impegnarsi con gli stakeholder senior, clienti e fornitori

• Sei fluente in tedesco e inglese

• Italiano o Francese sarebbe un plus

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altra caratteristica fantastica che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.

descriptions.en:
As Senior Business Analyst you will be a key member of Avaloq’s Banking Operations division, acting as a functional lead within the Asset Data Sourcing team. Banking Operations serves as the back office for more than 30 banks globally, ensuring efficient, compliant, and reliable processing across the Avaloq banking platform.
The Asset Data Sourcing team is responsible for the integration, mapping, governance, and distribution of financial instruments master data. In this role, you will take ownership of data sourcing activities for Avaloq’s global Financial Instruments Master Data Service (Asset Hub) and support the operational and strategic leadership of the team.
Your key tasks

• Overall responsibility and organization of Asset Data Sourcing service operations, as Senior Business Analyst

• Support team leadership through planning, prioritization and act as a senior escalation point for complex data, client, or vendor-related issues

• Overall Planning and implementation of asset, issuer, pricing etc. data migration projects

• Design and maintain complex business rules, mappings and specifications for successful releases

• Engaging with our clients in the capturing of their requirements and implementation (business analysis, functional specification, testing and releasing)

• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Banking Operations, IT, Product, and regional teams to deliver client-specific solutions within our Master Data Services

• As part of the vendor & change management, you will coordinate with data providers (with SIX Financial but also Bloomberg) and advise our internal data consumers on feed topics (VDFS/FLEX) and content

• In-depth knowledge of data vendor SIX Financial Information in the context of (VDFS) data feeds in the light of being a Service Facilitator towards SIX FI

## Qualifiche

• A proven IT or business qualification combined with a strong banking or financial services background

• Minimum 3 years’ experience as a Business Analyst in reference and market data management (e.g. Asset Hub of a Bank)

• Strong hands-on experience in financial instruments, master data, data delivery, Data modelling and target-system mapping

• In-depth knowledge in the SIX Financial Information data feed (VDF/VDFS) management of financial data content and data delivery

• A solid experience of the Enterprise Data Management system "Temenos DataSource” (TDS) is a mandatory

• Experience in TDS rule engine, configuration, customization and data modelling is highly desirable

• Practical knowledge in SQL. PL/SQL scripting is required

• Experience with the Avaloq Core Banking System is highly advantageous

• You are highly motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of critical topics, by providing supervision and direction

• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international teams

• Strong analytical mindset with a client-focused and solution-oriented approach

• Confident communicator, capable of engaging with senior stakeholders, clients, and vendors

• You are fluent in German and English

• Italian or French would be a plus

En tant qu'entreprise principale Analyste, vous serez un membre clé de la division des opérations bancaires d'Avaloq. Dans ce rôle, vous prendrez en charge les activités de sourcing de données pour Avaloq , le Service de Master Data d'instruments financiers mondiaux (Asset Hub) et soutenirez le leadership opérationnel et stratégique de l'équipe.
Vos tâches clés

• Responsabilité générale et organisation des opérations de services d'approvisionnement de données sur les biens, en tant qu'analyste principal des affaires

• Appuyer la direction de l'équipe en planifiant, en hiérarchisant et en servant de point d'escalade pour les questions complexes liées aux données, aux clients ou aux fournisseurs

• Planification et mise en œuvre globales des projets de migration des actifs, des émetteurs, des prix, etc.

• Concevoir et maintenir des règles opérationnelles complexes, des cartes et des spécifications pour les rejets réussis

• Participer avec nos clients à la saisie de leurs exigences et à leur mise en œuvre (analyse d'affaires, spécifications fonctionnelles, essais et diffusion)

• Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants internes de l'ensemble des équipes des opérations bancaires, des TI, des produits et des régions afin de fournir des solutions spécifiques à nos clients au sein de nos services Master Data

descriptions.fr:
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur logiciel hautement motivé pour rejoindre notre équipe de sortie dans le domaine Solution plate-forme CH/FL, avec un accent spécialisé sur l'extraction de données utilisant ACP (Avaloq Core Platform) et la génération de documents orientés vers le client, tels que des conseils et des énoncés de mise en page. Ce rôle est essentiel pour s'assurer que les données financières ou opérationnelles complexes sont extraites, transformées et présentées de façon claire, conforme et conviviale.
Vos tâches clés

• Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir des pipelines d'extraction de données en utilisant l'ACP pour récupérer des données structurées et non structurées des systèmes internes

• Élaborer et maintenir des processus automatisés pour produire des conseils et des énoncés de présentation adaptés à la gestion des communications avec les clients

• Collaborer avec les analystes d'affaires, les propriétaires de produits et les équipes de service à la clientèle pour définir les exigences de production et assurer l'alignement avec les objectifs opérationnels

• Assurer la qualité, l'uniformité et la rapidité de la prestation des communications avec les clients, y compris le formatage, l'image de marque et la localisation

• Optimiser la génération de sortie pour la performance, l'évolutivité et la maintenance

• Surveiller et dépanner les processus de sortie, en assurant l'intégrité des données et le respect des normes internes et externes

• Documenter les spécifications techniques, les flux de travail et les meilleures pratiques relatives à la production de produits et à l'extraction par les pays ACP

## Qualifiche

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, systèmes d'information ou domaine connexe

• 3+ ans d'expérience en génie logiciel, avec un accent sur l'extraction de données et la production de documents

• Fortes compétences en programmation dans des langages tels que Python, Java ou C#

• Expérience des moteurs de templatation et du formatage de sortie (p. ex. PDF, HTML, XML).

• La connaissance des normes d'information financière ou opérationnelle est plus

• Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et attention aux détails

• Fortes aptitudes en communication et capacité de travailler de façon interfonctionnelle
Ce serait un vrai bonus si vous aviez

• Expérience pratique avec ACP (Avaloq Core Platform) ou cadres similaires d'extraction de données

titles.en: Head of Reporting for Sales & Delivery

descriptions.it:
As the Head of Reporting for Sales and Delivery, you are accountable for the integrity, consistency and transparency of performance reporting across Sales and Project portfolios. You own the reporting frameworks, data governance standards and analytics architecture that enable reliable, decision-ready insights.
You will lead a team of professionals and drive the evolution of our reporting landscape, ensuring that data, tools and processes are structured to maximize analytical value. This is a strategic leadership role focused on translating complex data into actionable insights and enabling confident, data-driven decision-making at senior leadership level.
Your key tasks

• Own and evolve the end-to-end reporting landscape across Sales and Delivery, driving standardization of reporting frameworks, KPI definitions, data governance and tool architecture

• Deliver executive-level performance visibility by preparing and consolidating reporting for senior stakeholders (e.g. GEB, NEC), ensuring clarity, consistency and comparability of insights

• Lead performance review cadences, including Quarterly Review Sessions, providing structured analysis of performance against KPIs, trends and risks

• Act as a strategic advisor to business leaders, translating data into actionable insights to support operational performance and decision-making

• Lead and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement

• Drive the design and optimization of reporting tools and data models to enable scalable analytics and improved data accessibility

• Build strong cross-functional relationships, aligning reporting structures with business needs and ensuring adoption of governance standards through training and stakeholder engagement
What “Great” Looks Like in This Role

• Create one version of the truth across Sales and Delivery

• Turn reporting from a retrospective activity into a decision engine

• Establish clear governance without slowing down the business

• Enable leadership to act with confidence in the data

## Qualifiche

• Proven experience in a senior reporting, analytics, or performance management role, ideally within Sales, Delivery, or a comparable commercial environment

• Experience working with senior stakeholders (e.g. executive committees or board-level audiences), translating complex data into clear, actionable insights

• Strong understanding of CRM and project management systems and how to structure data for scalable analytics

titles.en: Technical Leader IT – Infrastructure & Platform Delivery
titles.de: Technical Leader IT – Infrastructure & Platform Delivery
titles.fr: Leader technique IT – Infrastructure et livraison des plateformes

descriptions.it:
Siamo alla ricerca di un Leader Tecnico IT con un forte background in infrastrutture e servizi di piattaforma (IaaS/PaaS), combinato con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, collaborazione e leadership tecnica.
Questo ruolo funge da ponte chiave tra team di ingegneria e stakeholder aziendali, assicurando che siano chiaramente compresi argomenti tecnici complessi e che la consegna sia allineata agli obiettivi aziendali.
I compiti chiave

• Condurre la fornitura tecnica di soluzioni di infrastruttura e piattaforma cloud, garantendo qualità, coerenza e scalabilità

• Agire come un ponte tra tecnologia e business, traducendo concetti tecnici complessi in insight chiari e attuabili

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con Project Manager e stakeholder aziendali per allineare priorità, vincoli e soluzioni

• Fornire una forte leadership tecnica alle squadre interfunzionali (interne ed esterne), promuovere la proprietà e la responsabilità

• Facilitare il processo decisionale tecnico, tra cui l'analisi di trade-off e la direzione architettonica

• Promuovere una mentalità collaborativa e orientata alla soluzione, gestire efficacemente le dipendenze e i conflitti

• Supporto di pianificazione tecnica, identificazione del rischio e strategie di mitigazione

• Guida le migliori pratiche nei domini cloud, automazione, sicurezza e resilienza

• Sviluppare e comunicare la roadmap tecnica per i servizi infrastrutturali e piattaforme, garantendo l'allineamento con la strategia organizzativa e gli obiettivi aziendali

• Mentore e sviluppo di membri del team tecnico, promuovendo una cultura dell'apprendimento continuo e della crescita professionale all'interno del dominio delle infrastrutture

• Monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni delle infrastrutture, l'efficienza dei costi e l'utilizzo delle risorse in ambienti OCI

• Gestire le relazioni dei fornitori e coordinare con i partner esterni per garantire la qualità dei servizi e la conformità contrattuale

• Stabilire e mantenere la documentazione tecnica completa, i repository di conoscenze e i runbook per supportare l'eccellenza operativa

• Superare la conformità con i quadri di governance IT, le politiche di sicurezza e i requisiti normativi nella consegna delle infrastrutture

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo, individuare opportunità per migliorare processi, strumenti e modelli architettonici

## Qualifiche

• Minimo 8+ anni di esperienza nell'infrastruttura IT, nei servizi della piattaforma cloud o nei ruoli tecnici correlati

• Esperienza dimostrata in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) o piattaforme cloud equivalenti (AWS, Azure)

• Forte background nella progettazione, distribuzione e gestione di soluzioni infrastrutturali scalabili

• Esperienza dimostrata con strumenti e framework di automazione infrastruttura-as-code (IaC)

• Registrazione dei principali team tecnici e iniziative di consegna delle infrastrutture di guida

• Esperienza con i framework IT Service Management (ITSM) e le migliori pratiche

• Conoscenza dei principi di sicurezza, conformità e governance del cloud

• Leader tecnico forte e collaborativo

• Comunicazione chiara ed efficace, con la capacità di semplificare la complessità

• Capacità di influenzare e costruire il consenso su diversi stakeholder

• mentalità orientata al team con forti competenze di collaborazione

• Approccio proattivo, responsabilità e orientamento dei risultati

• Pensiero strategico con la capacità di tradurre gli obiettivi aziendali in soluzioni tecniche
Sarebbe un vero bonus se avessi

• Certificazioni OCI (ad esempio, Architect Associate/Professional)

• Esperienza con Kubernetes e containerizzazione (ad esempio, OKE o piattaforme simili)

• Sfondo nei database aziendali (Oracle, PostgreSQL)

• Esperienza in ambienti cloud multi-cloud o ibridi

• Familiarità con la governance IT e i framework di consegna

• Esperienza dimostrata nell'ottimizzazione dei costi cloud e nella gestione delle risorse

• Sfondo con strumenti di monitoraggio, osservazione e gestione delle prestazioni

• Conoscenza di Italiano, Tedesco o Francese
La certificazione PMI non è necessaria; ciò che conta è una visione tecnologica ben arrotondata, una leadership forte e la capacità di guidare la consegna delle infrastrutture in ambienti OCI-centrici.

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.

As an OD Specialist you’ll help shape our organisation by leading strategic initiatives to improve effectiveness, culture, and capability. You’ll work with senior leaders, Strategic Business Partners and HR to drive change, support growth, and embed new ways of working at Avaloq. 

Your key tasks

• Strategic OD Consulting 

Partner with HR Leadership and business leaders to diagnose organisational challenges and co-create solutions that align with Strategic People Plan.

• Change & Transformation 

Lead and support change initiatives, including operating model redesigns, team effectiveness, and culture change, ensuring people are at the heart of transformation.

• Culture & Engagement 

Shape and embed our desired culture through values-led initiatives, employee listening strategies, and inclusive practices.

• Organisational Design 

Support structural design and workforce planning, ensuring alignment with business goals, scalability, and agility.

• Data-Driven Insights 

Use people analytics and qualitative insights to inform OD interventions, measure impact, and continuously improve.

• Collaboration & Capability Building 

Build OD capability across the HR and coach leaders to adopt systems thinking and adaptive leadership approaches. 

## Qualifiche

• Proven experience in OD, change management, or HR roles within fast-paced, complex environments  

• Strong consulting, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills

• Deep understanding of organisational systems, culture, and behavioural science

• Proven project management expertise and leading projects

• A strong customer focus, with proven capability to establish and maintain robust working relationships with senior managers up to C-suite level

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and influencing at senior levels

• Data-literate with the ability to translate insights into action

• Curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning

• Fluent in English

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices. 
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self. 
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way. 
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

titles.en: Project Manager – PMO & Governance (12-month fixed term contract)
titles.fr: Gestionnaire de projet – PMO & Gouvernance (contrat à durée déterminée de 12 mois)

descriptions.it:
Questa è una fantastica opportunità per un Project Manager esperto – Project Management Officer & Governance per aderire al nostro ufficio Bioggio e sostenere il nostro team di Project Delivery in vari argomenti organizzativi.
La nostra missione è quella di orchestrare i servizi trasversali end-to-end che permettono la consegna di successo dei progetti client garantendo al contempo i massimi livelli di qualità, trasparenza e soddisfazione del cliente. Nell'ambito del team Demand Management & PMO, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel sostenere il project e la governance del programma, la gestione delle risorse, la pianificazione finanziaria e il reporting del programma in un'organizzazione internazionale di consegna. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con Project Manager, Delivery Heads, PMO e stakeholder senior per guidare l'eccellenza operativa, promuovere la collaborazione e migliorare continuamente i processi di consegna, metodologie e strumenti.
I compiti chiave

• Sostenere la governance e la gestione di un programma di attuazione, assicurando una reportistica accurata su ambito, progresso, finanza, rischi, problemi e utilizzo delle risorse

• Gestire le attività di pianificazione della domanda e dell'offerta, tra cui l'allocazione delle risorse, la pianificazione della capacità, il monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e l'imbarco delle risorse esterne

• Coordinare le attività di progetto e portafoglio in più team, progetti e sedi internazionali, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e le priorità di consegna

• Preparare e fornire presentazioni di gestione di alta qualità, dashboard e comunicazioni esecutive per i comitati di leadership e sterzo senior

• Fornire un supporto efficiente e dettagliato in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto

• Sostegno al bilancio, alla previsione e al controllo dei processi

• Collabora con team legali, appalti, finanza e controllo

• Sostenere l'imbarco di nuovi membri del team

• Processi di audit di supporto

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo contribuendo ai quadri di gestione del progetto e agli standard di reporting

## Qualifiche

• Laurea o Master in Business Administration, Management Engineering, Informatica, Tecnologia dell'informazione, o un campo relativo

• 5+ anni di esperienza in Project Management, PMO, Portfolio Management, o un ruolo di coordinamento comparabile in un ambiente IT complesso

• Esperienza di lavoro nell'ambiente dei servizi bancari e finanziari

• Forte capacità analitiche, finanziarie e organizzative, con comprovata esperienza di previsione, controllo, reporting e gestione delle risorse

• Capacità di lavorare indipendentemente per obiettivi e tempi stabiliti

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con il senior management e il pubblico di livello executive

• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti internazionali e interfunzionali, con una mentalità proattiva, orientata alla soluzione e forti capacità di problem solving

• Proficienza dei prodotti Microsoft Office
Sarebbe un vero bonus se avessi

• Esperienza con metodi di consegna agili come Scrum e Kanban, oltre ai tradizionali framework di gestione dei progetti

• Esposizione all'utilizzo di Jira e Confluenza

• Conoscenze di lavoro di SAP

• Certificazioni PMP o PRINCE2

• Esperienza pratica con strumenti di gestione del portafoglio di progetti, piattaforme di reporting (ad esempio, Power BI) e sistemi di pianificazione delle risorse

• Competenze linguistiche tedesche (B2 Level+)

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.

Our mission is to orchestrate end-to-end transversal services that enable the successful delivery of client projects while ensuring the highest levels of quality, transparency, and customer satisfaction. As part of the Demand Management & PMO team, you will play a key role in supporting project and program governance, resource management, financial planning, and program reporting across an international delivery organization. You will work closely with Project Managers, Delivery Heads, PMOs, and senior stakeholders to drive operational excellence, foster collaboration, and continuously improve delivery processes, methodologies and tools.
Your key tasks

• Support the governance and management of an Implementation program, ensuring accurate reporting on scope, progress, financials, risks, issues, and resource utilization

• Manage demand and supply planning activities, including resource allocation, capacity planning, utilization tracking, and external resource onboarding

• Coordinate project and portfolio activities across multiple teams, projects, and international locations, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivery priorities

• Prepare and deliver high-quality management presentations, dashboards, and executive communications for senior leadership and steering committees

• Provide efficient and detail-oriented support throughout the project lifecycle

• Support budgeting, forecasting and controlling processes

• Collaborate with Legal, Procurement, Finance and Controlling teams

• Support the onboarding of new team members

• Support auditing processes

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by contributing to project management frameworks and reporting standards

## Qualifiche

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

• 5+ years of experience in Project Management, PMO, Portfolio Management, or a comparable coordination role within a complex IT environment

• Experience working in the banking and financial services environment

• Strong analytical, financial, and organizational skills, with proven experience in forecasting, controlling, reporting, and resource management

• Ability to work independently to established goals and timelines

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior management and executive-level audiences

• Experience working in international and cross-functional environments, with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and strong problem-solving abilities

• Proficiency of Microsoft Office products
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Experience with agile delivery methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban, as well as traditional project management frameworks

• Exposure to using Jira and Confluence

• Working knowledge of SAP

As a Senior Database Platform Engineer, you will help transform Oracle database operations into a fully automated, secure, and scalable platform. Working within an agile delivery team, you will design and maintain automation across the entire database lifecycle, ensuring reliable, auditable, and resilient database services while minimizing manual intervention.
Your key tasks

• Automate the complete Oracle database lifecycle, including provisioning, cloning, refresh, reconfiguration, backup, restore, and decommissioning using Terraform, Ansible, and scripting.

• Develop and maintain automation that provisions databases to Avaloq standards and performs post-clone configuration without manual intervention.

• Deliver and operate automated workflows for day-to-day database operations, including restart, resize, housekeeping, parameter changes, Oracle Home switches, and standard incident recovery actions.

descriptions.it:
We are looking for a passionate Cloud Security Architect to join our Cloud Architecture team. This role combines cloud architecture and security engineering with automation, and DevSecOps practices to help design and secure next-generation cloud platforms and services.

Your Key Tasks

• Design, govern, and continuously evolve secure cloud architectures for SaaS, PaaS, and internal platforms

• Define and maintain cloud security standards, reusable architecture patterns, reference architectures, and security blueprints

• Embed security-by-design principles into landing zones, tenancy structures, network segmentation, identity models, and cloud guardrails

• Drive the adoption of Zero Trust, least-privilege, and defense-in-depth security strategies across the cloud landscape

• Integrate security controls and compliance requirements into CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and platform automation frameworks

• Lead or support security assessments, threat modeling, risk analysis, and architecture reviews

• Provide architectural guidance for network security and connectivity designs across internal, SaaS, and PaaS environments

• Partner with the Network Architecture team to define enterprise network standards and reusable architecture patterns, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant connectivity solutions across all platforms and environments

• Ensure alignment with regulatory, compliance, and security requirements, translating them into practical and implementable architectural solutions

• Evaluate emerging cloud security technologies and drive continuous improvements in the organization's security posture
Collaboration & Mentoring

• Work closely with Cloud Architects, Platform Engineers, DevOps teams, Security Operations, and Product teams

• Provide guidance and coaching on secure cloud adoption

• Help drive cloud transformation and modernization initiatives

• Collaborate with engineering teams to improve automation, reliability, and operational security

## Qualifiche

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience as an IT Security Architect, Cloud Security Architect, or in a similar senior security or architecture role

• Experience designing and governing enterprise cloud architectures in Cloud Infrastructure (OCI preferred)

• Experience with Cloud Network Architecture, managing complex network topologies and related topics

• Experience with risk assessments, threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and security-by-design methodologies

• Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation technologies such as Terraform/OpenTofu, CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, and Policy-as-Code
The following certifications are considered a strong advantage:

• CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

• CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

• OCI Security Architect Professional

• OCI certifications in Cloud Security and Network Architecture

• Equivalent architecture or cybersecurity certifications

descriptions.it:
The Legal Reporting team is looking for a committed and competent Technical Business Analyst to carry out requirement analysis, solution design and parameterization activities on Legal Reporting domain. As member of the Legal Reporting team you will be part of an Agile team that implement high quality and standardized solution for Swiss / European Banks. We work closely together and with other teams, therefore we are looking for a new colleague who – in addition to being independent – also enjoys collaborating with others!

Your key tasks

• Analyse European Bank Authority EBA and Country Regulatory requirements

• Processes according to bank scope by developing standardized solution with Reporting Tool: Fire, WKFS, ABACUS or similar

• Help our customer to be compliant with regulators such EBA, BCL, CSSF, SNB, FINMA, NBB, BDF

• Build and parameterize Regulatory reporting solutions in Avaloq (training will be provided) in an Agile environment

• Participate in implementation workshops

• Actively manage Internal and External Stakeholders relationship by communicating regularly during the implementation

• Place of work Bioggio/Remote with possibility to join client project for on-site working group across Europe and Asia

## Qualifiche

• University degree in Computer Science/Engineering/Mathematics or equivalent Business degree

• Strong analytical, problem solving and conceptual skills

• Strong command of the English language

• Excellent client-orientation and strong communication skills with a service-oriented attitude

• Proactive, self-motivated with passion for learning and self-improvement
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Experience with banking industry/systems/Avaloq Banking Suite

• Experiences with SQL / PLSQL

• Experiences with Legal Reporting Tool Fire, WKFS, ABACUS or similar

• Experiences with Regulators EBA, BCL, CSSF, SNB, FINMA, NBB, BDF

• Italian, German and French are a plus

descriptions.it:
Il team Cash Operations & Payments nei Servizi di Gestione delle Applicazioni (AMS) è responsabile di fornire la manutenzione delle applicazioni (accoppiamento dei costi) e piccoli servizi di valorizzazione per l'area funzionale e tutti i relativi argomenti per i nostri clienti SaaS, in stretta collaborazione con il dipartimento Back-Office.

I compiti chiave

• Collaborare con il Team Lead, gli analisti aziendali e altri ingegneri software

• Scrivere progetti di soluzione per nuovi sviluppi e li hanno recensiti con i nostri lead tecnici e architetti

• Partecipa ai workshop dei clienti e supporta i nostri analisti aziendali nell'analisi dei requisiti

• Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere soluzioni di pensiero all’interno della responsabilità del team

• Migliorare e ottimizzare le funzionalità esistenti

• Sviluppare e mantenere test automatizzati, assicurazione qualità

• Assumere la proprietà e la responsabilità per la vostra area di competenza

• Per lavorare con le piattaforme di mentalità agile, processo e ticketing (Jira)

## Qualifiche

• Forte comprovata esperienza di sviluppo software di almeno 3 anni

• Buona conoscenza e comprensione del suono delle tecnologie del database (SQL, Oracle PL/SQL)

• Impaziente di imparare e capire le esigenze aziendali che mirano a fornire disegni puliti e codice di alta qualità

• Forte mente concettuale e analitica con un approccio strutturato e autonomo al lavoro su complessi problemi tecnici e aziendali
Sarebbe un vero bonus se avessi

• Esperienza nell'industria finanziaria e/o operazioni di cassa e temi di pagamento

• Laurea in Informatica o disciplina relativa (preferibile)

• Conoscenza degli standard specifici di dominio per i pagamenti, come SIC, euroSIC, SEPA e SWIFT MT o MX (ISO20022)

## Informazioni

Ci rendiamo conto che gestire l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa è una sfida che tutti affrontiamo nella nostra vita quotidiana e per sostenere questo siamo lieti di offrire un lavoro ibrido e flessibile per la maggior parte dei nostri Avaloqers per mantenere l'equilibrio della vita lavorativa e continuare ancora la nostra fantastica cultura Avaloq nei nostri uffici globali.
In Avaloq siamo orgogliosi di abbracciare la diversità e comprendere il successo del nostro business è costruito sulla potenza di opinioni diverse, siamo pienamente impegnati a promuovere un ambiente pari opportunità e una cultura inclusiva dove si può essere il vostro vero sé autentico.
Assumiamo, compenseremo e promuoviamo indipendentemente dall'origine, dall'età, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale o da qualsiasi altro fantastico tratto che ci rende tutti unici, abbiamo fatto del nostro meglio per scrivere questo annuncio in modo inclusivo e neutro.
Si prega di essere consapevoli che non accetteremo le candidature speculative per uno qualsiasi dei nostri ruoli da agenzie di reclutamento, e qualsiasi presentazione candidato non richiesto sarà esente da eventuali aspettative di pagamento.

• Design, govern, and continuously evolve secure cloud architectures for SaaS, PaaS, and internal platforms

• Define and maintain cloud security standards, reusable architecture patterns, reference architectures, and security blueprints

• Embed security-by-design principles into landing zones, tenancy structures, network segmentation, identity models, and cloud guardrails

• Drive the adoption of Zero Trust, least-privilege, and defense-in-depth security strategies across the cloud landscape

• Integrate security controls and compliance requirements into CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and platform automation frameworks

• Lead or support security assessments, threat modeling, risk analysis, and architecture reviews

• Provide architectural guidance for network security and connectivity designs across internal, SaaS, and PaaS environments

• Partner with the Network Architecture team to define enterprise network standards and reusable architecture patterns, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant connectivity solutions across all platforms and environments

• Ensure alignment with regulatory, compliance, and security requirements, translating them into practical and implementable architectural solutions

• Evaluate emerging cloud security technologies and drive continuous improvements in the organization's security posture
Collaboration & Mentoring

• Work closely with Cloud Architects, Platform Engineers, DevOps teams, Security Operations, and Product teams

• Provide guidance and coaching on secure cloud adoption

• Help drive cloud transformation and modernization initiatives

• Collaborate with engineering teams to improve automation, reliability, and operational security

## Qualifiche

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience as an IT Security Architect, Cloud Security Architect, or in a similar senior security or architecture role

• Experience designing and governing enterprise cloud architectures in Cloud Infrastructure (OCI preferred)

• Experience with Cloud Network Architecture, managing complex network topologies and related topics

• Experience with risk assessments, threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and security-by-design methodologies

• Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation technologies such as Terraform/OpenTofu, CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, and Policy-as-Code
The following certifications are considered a strong advantage:

• CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

• CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

• OCI Security Architect Professional

• OCI certifications in Cloud Security and Network Architecture

• Equivalent architecture or cybersecurity certifications

We are seeking a highly skilled Test Specialist to join our dynamic team in Bioggio, Switzerland. As a key member of the project team, you will be responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software to the client.
Your key tasks

• Develop and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts for complex software applications

• Proactively propose and adopt best practices and methodologies for test, including harnessing AI

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve software defects

• Analyse test results and provide detailed reports to stakeholders

• Conduct performance testing and identify areas for optimization

• Work closely with project manager, development teams and other stakeholders to manage risks and issues

• Design, update and execute functional and business test scenarios and test cases based on functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring their reusability

• Support test environments issues to ensure testing can be completed on time (baseline definition and maintenance, assessment on environment readiness)

• Document and evaluate the result of the testing, investigate testing deficiencies

• Adhere closely to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) concepts

• Support and maintain automated testing frameworks to improve efficiency and coverage

• Contribute to continuous improvement of Test Management processes and procedures

## Qualifiche

• University degree in Computer Science, or similar

• Minimum of 3-5 years of work experience within the banking/financial services industry, especially in testing function

• In-depth knowledge of Test concepts and methodology

• Excellent written/verbal communication skills in English with an emphasis on client service and presentation

• Must be an excellent team player and willing to share knowledge as well ad high level of stress management ability

• Working knowledge of QC/ALM, JIRA, MS Office Suite

• Strong analytical and problem-solving competences

• Team player and strong client-orientation

descriptions.it:
We are seeking a Senior Data Platform Engineer to design, build, and operate a scalable, secure, and governed data platform supporting security, audit, operational, and analytics workloads.
This role is primarily focused on data engineering and data platform development, including data architecture, ingestion pipelines, data modeling, quality controls, governance, and integration with analytics and security platforms. The successful candidate will have strong experience designing and operating data platforms, building reliable batch and streaming pipelines, and managing large volumes of structured and semi-structured data.
The role requires close collaboration with security, infrastructure, and application teams to deliver trusted, high-quality data that enables monitoring, reporting, threat detection, compliance, and business insights.
Your key tasks
Data Platform Architecture

• Design and evolve scalable data platform architectures for security, audit, operational, and analytics data

• Define data storage strategies, schemas, data models, partitioning, retention, and lifecycle management approaches

• Evaluate and prototype new technologies and architectures to improve scalability, performance, and cost efficiency
Data Engineering & Pipelines

• Design, build, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines

• Develop robust ingestion frameworks for logs, audit data, application events, security telemetry, and operational datasets

• Implement data transformation, enrichment, normalization, correlation, and aggregation processes

• Ensure pipelines are reliable, scalable, observable, and resilient
Data Modeling & Storage

• Design relational, analytical, and event-based data models

• Optimize database structures, query performance, indexing, and storage efficiency

• Support the implementation of data lake, warehouse, and lakehouse concepts where appropriate
Data Quality & Governance

• Define and implement data quality controls across ingestion and transformation layers

• Develop validation, reconciliation, deduplication, and completeness checks

• Support data lineage, metadata management, ownership, retention, auditability, and regulatory requirements

• Implement controls for sensitive and regulated data
Platform Integration & Analytics Enablement

• Integrate data from diverse internal and external platforms, applications, databases, APIs, and messaging systems

• Deliver curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, observability, compliance, and security operations

• Support integration with SIEM, monitoring, and business intelligence platforms

• Collaborate with analytics and reporting teams to improve data accessibility and usability
Engineering & Automation

• Develop data engineering services, tooling, and automation using Python and SQL

• Contribute to CI/CD practices for data platform components

• Support infrastructure automation where required, using Terraform and related tooling

• Maintain engineering standards, documentation, and operational procedures

## Qualifiche

• 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Database Engineering, or a related field

• Strong SQL expertise, including schema design, data modeling, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning

• Experience designing and operating production-grade batch and/or streaming data pipelines

• Experience with large-scale data platforms and analytical data architectures

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL

• Experience integrating data from multiple sources, platforms, APIs, and event streams

• Strong understanding of data quality, schema evolution, lineage, governance, and lifecycle management

• Experience with relational databases and analytical storage technologies

• Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and Git-based development practices

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills

• Experience working with sensitive, security-relevant, or regulated data
Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Kafka or other streaming and messaging technologies

• Hands-on administration and search query development with Splunk (SPL) or alternative SIEM/observability stacks (Elasticsearch/Logstash/Kibana, Datadog)

• Experience with modern data platform technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi, Trino, Spark or Parquet

• Experience with data lakehouse architectures

• Experience implementing data quality frameworks and data governance controls

• Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage, and metadata management solutions

• Experience integrating data platforms with analytics tools such as Apache Superset, Power BI, Tableau, or Metabase

• Experience in banking, fintech, cybersecurity, or other regulated industries

• Working knowledge of Terraform and cloud-based data platforms
It would be a real bonus if you have

• Security telemetry and audit-event processing

• SIEM and observability integrations

• Compliance and regulatory reporting datasets

• AI/ML-ready data platform architectures

• Real-time analytics and event-driven architectures

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

descriptions.it:
As the Head of FP&A and Controlling, you are the architect of our financial future. This is a high-impact, strategic leadership position designed for a finance expert who can translate complex data into actionable business intelligence, partnering with the business to maximize the value of Avaloq.
You will lead a high-performing multi-country team of 20+, overseeing everything from rigorous bottom-up budgeting to high-level strategic long-range planning and daily controllership for our departments. You will be the CFO’s right hand, ensuring that our financial steering, business partnering, and controlling functions align perfectly with our growth targets.
Key tasks:
Strategic financial planning & analysis

• Lead the development of long-term financial strategies and 3–5 year models that support global expansion and capital allocation in line with our mid-term plan aspirations.

• Conduct sophisticated "what-if" analyses and risk assessments to evaluate potential business outcomes and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

• Analyze industry trends and the competitive landscape to shape effective strategies and establish market standard KPIs to track organizational success.
Advanced controlling & reporting

• Define and oversee our financial steering model and drive finance-related performance management, systematically assessing outcomes and improvement measures.

• Partner with accounting teams to ensure accurate information flow and implement reporting processes that enhance financial transparency across the organization.

• Deep-dive into financial data to identify trends, pinpoint variances, and provide the "narrative" behind the numbers to stakeholders.
Budgeting & cost management

• Establish clear budget guidelines and monitor performance against forecasts to identify areas for cost savings and operational efficiencies

• Implement rigorous cost control methodologies, assessing how cost changes affect profitability and collaborating with department heads to manage key cost drivers.

• Review and approve budget requests based on strategic priorities, ensuring any money spent aligns with organizational goals.
Leadership & business partnering

• Lead and scale a diverse team, fostering a collaborative environment through regular performance evaluations, constructive feedback, and professional development.

• Act as a strategic consultant to business leaders, providing the financial insights necessary to enhance operational performance and decision-making.

• Build strong relationships across the firm, facilitating workshops and training sessions for non-financial managers to synchronize financial goals with operational plans.

• Collaborate with IT and project team to modernize our ERP systems and financial information tools, ensuring the team has the best-in-class cloud-based tech stack for financial management.

## Qualifiche

• 12+ years of senior finance experience, including 5+ years in FP&A and a minimum of 3+ years in a senior leadership role managing teams.

• Evidencible proficiency in advanced financial modelling, forecasting, and cost analysis, with strong mastery of ERP systems, financial reporting software, and data visualisation tools.

• Strong proficiency in financial modelling, forecasting and cost analysis and expert experience of working with ERP systems, financial reporting software, and data visualisation tools.

• Proven capability to set enterprise-level goals and strategies within complex environments.
It would be a real bonus if you have:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. An MBA or Master’s degree in a finance-related discipline

## Informazioni aggiuntive

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
